statements.label: def:marked:potential-loads
statements.title: Potential marked wheel loads
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Potential marked wheel loads]
\label{def:marked:potential-loads}
Fix integers $c\ge8$, $b\ge0$, disjoint finite sets $V,W$, a simple
graph $P$ on $V$ and a permutation $\pi$ of $V$. In the following
formulas typed arcs and spokes are
occurrences, not their unordered physical images. Extend
\eqref{eq:physical:image-map} to potential arcs by
$\operatorname{phys}(x,y,0)=\{x,y\}$ and $\operatorname{phys}(x,y,K)=\{x,\pi(y)\}$.
The potential occurrences are
\[
 \mathfrak E_P=
 \{(x,y,j):x,y\in V,\ j\in\{0,K\},\ \operatorname{phys}(x,y,j)\in E(P)\}
 \dot\cup (V\times W\times\{0,K\}).
\]
Let $E(\mathcal Q)\subseteq\mathfrak E_P$.
Fix a family $\mathcal W_P$ of typed marked $c$-wheels in $\mathfrak E_P$,
each with distinct loopless physical edges, and a function
$w_0:\mathcal W_P\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$.
Any separation restriction is fixed as part of $\mathcal W_P$.
For $e\in\mathfrak E_P$, define
\begin{equation}
 \widehat L_e(\mathcal Q;w_0)=
 \sum_{\substack{W'\in\mathcal W_P\\e\in E(W')}}w_0(W')
       \prod_{f\in E(W')\setminus\{e\}}\ind_{\{f\in E(\mathcal Q)\}}.
 \label{eq:loads:marked-potential-seed}
\end{equation}
When $w_0$ is fixed, write $\widehat L_e(\mathcal Q)=\widehat L_e(\mathcal Q;w_0)$.
The product omits precisely the root occurrence $e$.
The formula is defined even when $e\notin E(\mathcal Q)$, and does
not require the physical image map to be injective on all of $E(\mathcal Q)$.
For a $(b,\pi)$-separated typed marked cycle $C$ whose physical
rim edges are distinct, loopless and contained in $P$, put
\begin{equation}
 \widehat H_C(\mathcal Q)=\sum_{u\in W}\prod_{v\in V(C)}
            \ind_{\{(v,u,t_C(v))\in E(\mathcal Q)\}}.
 \label{eq:loads:marked-potential-hubs}
\end{equation}
No rim indicator occurs in this product. The count of
$\mathcal F_j(v,v';u,u')$ omits its four root spokes;
$|\mathcal C(u,u')|$ omits none of its required arcs or spokes.
The potential occurrences $\mathfrak E_P$, wheel family $\mathcal W_P$
and function $w_0$ stay fixed as $\mathcal Q$ varies; the sums use the
displayed edge indicators to determine which configurations occur.
\end{definition}

statements.label: lem:four:typed-correction
statements.title: A sparse fixed-type correction
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[A sparse fixed-type correction]
\label{lem:four:typed-correction}
Fix an integer $c\ge4$, $\omega,h>0$, and $0<\delta_0<1/4$.
Let $0<1/n\ll\eta\ll\xi\ll1/c,\omega,h,\delta_0$.
Let $V,W$ be disjoint with $|V|=n$ and
$\omega n\le|W|\le n$. Let $R^0,R^K$ be digraphs on $V$ and
$H^0,H^K$ bipartite graphs on $V,W$, and put
$\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$. Let $a^+,a^-,a^K,a^W$ be the
four functions in \eqref{eq:typed:imbalance} for this tuple. Let $\pi$ be a permutation of a finite set
$V^*\supseteq V$. For $j\in\{0,K\}$ let
$F_{R,j}\subseteq D_{R^j}$ and $F_{H,j}\subseteq H^j$ be subgraphs.
Suppose that all four graphs $D_{R^j}-F_{R,j}$ and $H^j-F_{H,j}$
satisfy the $(\delta_0,h)$ large-cut condition \eqref{eq:cuts:large}, and that
\[
 |a^+(v)|,|a^-(v)|,|a^K(v)|\le\eta n\quad(v\in V),\qquad
 |a^W(w)|\le\eta n\quad(w\in W).
\]
Then there are subgraphs $J_R^j\subseteq R^j$ and $J_H^j\subseteq H^j$ with
\[
 \beta_{R^j}(E(J_R^j))\cap E(F_{R,j})=\varnothing,\qquad
 E(J_H^j)\cap E(F_{H,j})=\varnothing\quad(j\in\{0,K\}),
\]
such that $(R^0-J_R^0,R^K-J_R^K,H^0-J_H^0,H^K-J_H^K)$ is marked
$c$-wheel-divisible. Put
\[
 J=E(J_R^0)\dot\cup E(J_R^K)
   \dot\cup E(J_H^0)\dot\cup E(J_H^K),
\]
where the disjoint union retains the types. Then
\[
 \Delta_{\rm aux}(J)\le100c\xi n.
\]
For $z\in V^*$ define the physical incident counts
\[
\begin{aligned}
 d_0(z)&=\sum_{xy\in E(J_R^0)}(\ind_{\{x=z\}}+\ind_{\{y=z\}}),\\
 d_K(z)&=\sum_{xy\in E(J_R^K)}(\ind_{\{x=z\}}+\ind_{\{\pi(y)=z\}}).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then $d_j(z)\le100c\xi n$ for every $j\in\{0,K\}$ and $z\in V^*$.
The sums count edge occurrences, including both incidences of a loop.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:relative-ordinary-correction
statements.title: Sparse ordinary degree correction
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Sparse ordinary degree correction]
\label{lem:new:relative-ordinary-correction}
Fix an integer \(r\ge3\), \(\omega,h>0\) and \(0<\delta_0<1/4\).
Let $0<1/n\ll\eta\ll\xi\ll1/r,\omega,h,\delta_0$.
Let \(Q\) be a simple graph on \(V\), with \(|V|=n\), and
let \(H\) be a simple bipartite graph on \(V,U\), with
\(\omega n\le s:=|U|\le n\).
Let $F_Q\subseteq Q$ and $F_H\subseteq H$ be forbidden subgraphs
(possibly empty), let $\vec Q$ be an orientation of $Q-F_Q$,
and let $D_Q=D_{\vec Q}$ be its tail--head bipartite graph.
Suppose $D_Q$ and $H-F_H$ satisfy
\eqref{eq:cuts:large} with parameters $\delta_0,h$.
Put $b(v)=d_Q(v)-2d_H(v)$ for $v\in V$, and assume
$|b(v)|\le\eta n$ for every $v\in V$.
Then there are subgraphs $J_Q\subseteq Q-F_Q$ and $J_H\subseteq H-F_H$
such that
\[
 d_{Q-J_Q}(v)=2d_{H-J_H}(v)\quad(v\in V),\qquad
 \Delta(J_Q\cup J_H)\le10\xi n.
 \tag{O5}\label{eq:new:late:O5}
\]
Moreover \(r\mid d_{H-J_H}(u)\) for every $u\in U$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:packing:ordinary-deletion-stability
statements.title: Ordinary wheel counts under sparse deletions
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Ordinary wheel counts under sparse deletions]
\label{lem:packing:ordinary-deletion-stability}
Fix integers $r\ge3$, $k\ge r+2$ and $b_+>0$.
There are $C_S,C_T,C_L>0$, depending only on $r,k,b_+$, with the
following property. Let $n\ge1$, $t\ge0$ and $\vartheta,\alpha>0$.
Let $V,U$ be disjoint with $|V|=n$, $|U|\le n$, let $P,\mathcal F$
be graphs on $V$, and let $Q\subseteq P-E(\mathcal F)$ and
$H\subseteq V\times U$. Let $F_Q\subseteq Q$ and $F_H\subseteq H$
satisfy $\Delta(F_Q\cup F_H)\le tn$, and put
$Q^-=Q-F_Q$, $H^-=H-F_H$.

Put
\[
\begin{split}
 \mathcal W_P&=\{W(C,u):C\in\mathcal C_r(P),\ u\in U,
                                  \ E(\mathcal F[V(C)])=\varnothing\},\\
 \mathcal W(Q,H)&=\{W\in\mathcal W_P:E(W)\subseteq E(Q)\cup E(H)\}.
\end{split}
\]
Let $w:\mathcal W_P\to[0,b_+n^{1-r}]$.
The sums $\widehat I_e(Q,H)$ and $\widehat T_{v,u,u'}(Q,H)$
are defined by \eqref{eq:loads:ordinary-potential-isolators} and
\eqref{eq:loads:ordinary-potential-transfers}; write
$\widehat L_e(Q,H;w)$ for \eqref{eq:loads:ordinary-potential-seed}
with coefficient function $w$.

Then, with the same function $w$ in both load sums,
\[
\begin{aligned}
0\le{}&\widehat I_e(Q,H)-\widehat I_e(Q^-,H^-)\le C_St
 &&(e\in E(P-E(\mathcal F))),\\
0\le{}&\widehat T_{v,u,u'}(Q,H)-\widehat T_{v,u,u'}(Q^-,H^-)\le C_Tt
 &&(v\in V,\ u\ne u'\in U),\\
0\le{}&\widehat L_e(Q,H;w)-\widehat L_e(Q^-,H^-;w)\le C_Lt
 &&(e\in E(P-E(\mathcal F))\dot\cup(V\times U)).
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:relative-ordinary-packing
statements.title: Approximate ordinary wheel packing from near balance
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Approximate ordinary wheel packing from near balance]
\label{lem:new:relative-ordinary-packing}
Fix an integer $r\ge3$, $\alpha,\omega,\beta,b_-,b_+,h_c>0$,
$0<\delta_c<1/4$, and an integer
\[
 k\ge\max\{r+2,m_0(r,\alpha/4)\},
\]
where $m_0$ is from Lemma~\ref{lem:four:edge-isolator}.
There is $\varepsilon_*>0$ such that for every $\gamma>0$ there are
$\eta>0$ and $n_0\in\mathbb N$ with the following property.

Let $n\ge n_0$, let $V,U$ be disjoint with $|V|=n$ and
$\omega n\le|U|\le n$, let $P,\mathcal F$ be graphs on $V$, let
$Q\subseteq P-E(\mathcal F)$, and let $H\subseteq V\times U$.
Let $\vec Q$ be an orientation of $Q$ and put $D_Q=D_{\vec Q}$.
Use the $k$-set family $\mathcal S(xy,u)$ in
\eqref{eq:ordinary:isolator-sets} and the labelled family
$\mathcal T(v,u,u')$ in Section~\ref{sec:ordinary:transfer-configurations},
with $(P,Q,H,\mathcal F)$ as above and
$\vartheta=\max\{1/2,\delta_{C_r}\}$.
Assume
\begin{equation}
\begin{gathered}
 d_H(v)\ge\beta n,\qquad |d_Q(v)-2d_H(v)|\le\eta n\quad(v\in V),\\
 \sum_{u\in N_H(x)\cap N_H(y)}|\mathcal S(xy,u)|\ge\beta n^{k-1}
       \quad(xy\in E(Q)),\\
 |\mathcal T(v,u,u')|\ge\beta n^{r^2}
       \quad(v\in V,\ u\ne u'\in N_H(v)).
\end{gathered}
\label{eq:packing:ordinary-supplies}
\end{equation}
Put
\[
 \mathcal W=\{(C,u)\in\mathcal W_r^{\rm ord}((V,U,Q,H)):
                 E(\mathcal F[V(C)])=\varnothing\}.
\]
Suppose $w_0:\mathcal W\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ satisfies
\[
 b_-n^{1-r}\le w_0(W)\le b_+n^{1-r},\qquad
 \left|\sum_{W\ni e}w_0(W)-1\right|\le\varepsilon_*
       \quad(e\in E(Q)\cup E(H)).
\]
Assume $H$ and $D_Q$ satisfy the $(\delta_c,h_c)$ large-cut condition
\eqref{eq:cuts:large}. Then there is a packing
$\mathcal P\subseteq\mathcal W$ whose remainder
$L=(Q\cup H)-\bigcup_{W\in\mathcal P}E(W)$ satisfies
\begin{equation}
 \Delta(L)\le\gamma n.
 \label{eq:packing:ordinary-output}
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:packing:marked-deletion-stability
statements.title: Marked wheel counts under sparse deletions
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Marked wheel counts under sparse deletions]
\label{lem:packing:marked-deletion-stability}
Fix an integer $c\ge8$ and $b_+,\omega_W>0$.
There is $C=C(c,b_+)>0$ with the following property.
Let $b\ge0$, $n\ge1$ be integers and let $t\ge0$.
Let $V,W$ be disjoint sets with $|V|=n$ and $\omega_Wn\le|W|\le n$,
let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$, and let
$\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a physically injective typed graph
on $(V,W,\pi)$.
Let $F\subseteq E(\mathcal Q)$ be a typed edge set with
$\Delta_{\rm aux}(F),\Delta_{\rm phys}(F)\le tn$, and put
$\mathcal Q^-=\mathcal Q-F$. Write $(R^j)^-,(H^j)^-$ for its
components and $R^-=(R^0)^-\dot\cup(R^K)^-$.
For $\mathcal R\in\{\mathcal Q,\mathcal Q^-\}$, use its compatible
hub sets $W_C(\mathcal R)$, common marked-cycle families
$\mathcal C(u,u';\mathcal R)$ and common marked-path families
$\mathcal F_j(v,v';u,u';\mathcal R)$, all with separation $(b,\pi)$.
Let $\omega_0:\mathcal W(\mathcal Q)\to[0,b_+n^{1-c}]$ and put
$\omega_0^-=\omega_0|_{\mathcal W(\mathcal Q^-)}$.

Then
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
0\le{}&d_{R^j}^{\pm}(v)-d_{(R^j)^-}^{\pm}(v)\le tn
 &&(j\in\{0,K\},\ v\in V),\\
0\le{}&d_{H^j}(z)-d_{(H^j)^-}(z)\le tn
 &&(j\in\{0,K\},\ z\in V\cup W),\\
0\le{}&|N^+_{R^0}(x)\cap N^-_{R^0}(y)|
       -|N^+_{(R^0)^-}(x)\cap N^-_{(R^0)^-}(y)|\le2tn
 &&(x\ne y\in V),\\
0\le{}&|W_C(\mathcal Q)|-|W_C(\mathcal Q^-)|\le ctn
 &&(C\in\mathcal C_{R^-}),\\
0\le{}&|\mathcal C(u,u';\mathcal Q)|-|\mathcal C(u,u';\mathcal Q^-)|\le Ctn^c
 &&(u\ne u'\in W),\\
0\le{}&|\mathcal F_j(v,v';u,u';\mathcal Q)|
       -|\mathcal F_j(v,v';u,u';\mathcal Q^-)|\le Ctn^{c-1}
 &&\begin{gathered}(j\in\{0,K\},\ v\ne v'\in V,\\ u\ne u'\in W),\end{gathered}\\
0\le{}&L_{\omega_0}(e)-L_{\omega_0^-}(e)\le Ct
 &&(e\in E_{\rm phys}(\mathcal Q^-)).
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:packing:marked-deletion}
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:packing:marked-potential-stability
statements.title: Potential marked loads under sparse deletions
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Potential marked loads under sparse deletions]
\label{lem:packing:marked-potential-stability}
Fix an integer $c\ge8$ and $b_+,\omega_W>0$. There is $C=C(c,b_+)>0$
with the following property. Let $b\ge0$, $n\ge1$ be integers and $t\ge0$.
Let $V,W$ be disjoint sets with $|V|=n$, $\omega_Wn\le|W|\le n$, and let
$\pi$ be a permutation of $V$. Let $\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$
be a physically injective typed graph on $(V,W,\pi)$.
Let $F\subseteq E(\mathcal Q)$ be a typed edge set with
$\Delta_{\rm aux}(F),\Delta_{\rm phys}(F)\le tn$, and put
$\mathcal Q^-=\mathcal Q-F$.
Fix a graph $P$ on $V$ containing all physical rim images.
Use the potential marked occurrences $\mathfrak E_P$ on $P,V,W$.
Let $\mathcal C_P$ consist of the $(b,\pi)$-separated marked
$c$-cycles in this set with distinct loopless physical rim images.
Fix a family $\mathcal W_P$ of marked $c$-wheels with distinct
loopless physical edges and weights $w:\mathcal W_P\to[0,b_+n^{1-c}]$.
Use the potential marked wheel loads
$\widehat L_e(\mathcal R;w)$ and $\widehat H_C(\mathcal R)$,
for $\mathcal R=\mathcal Q,\mathcal Q-F$, with the same families
$\mathcal C_P,\mathcal W_P$, physical map $\operatorname{phys}$ and function $w$.
Then
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
 0&\le\widehat H_C(\mathcal Q)-\widehat H_C(\mathcal Q^-)\le ctn
       &&(C\in\mathcal C_P),\\
 0&\le\widehat L_e(\mathcal Q;w)-\widehat L_e(\mathcal Q^-;w)\le Ct
       &&(e\in\mathfrak E_P).
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:packing:marked-potential-deletion}
\end{equation}
The families $\mathcal C_P,\mathcal W_P$ and $w$ are fixed at both hosts.
No rim edge of $C$, or root $e$, is required to belong to either host.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:relative-marked-packing
statements.title: Approximate marked wheel packing from near divisibility
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Approximate marked wheel packing from near divisibility]
\label{lem:new:relative-marked-packing}
Fix $0<\alpha<1/4$, $0<p_{\rm rim}<1/2$, and
$p_*,\beta,b_-,b_+,\omega_W,h_c'>0$, with $b_-\le b_+$, and fix
$0<\delta_c'<1/4$. Let
$c\ge\max\{8,c_0(\alpha,p_{\rm rim})\}$ be even, where $c_0$ is from
Theorem~\ref{thm:capacity:marked-numerical}. There are
$\varepsilon_0,\eta_0,\delta_0>0$ such that for every $\gamma>0$ there
is $\eta>0$ with the following property. For every integer $b\ge2$
there is $n_0\in\mathbb N$ such that the following holds for every
$n\ge n_0$ and every $p\in[p_{\rm rim},1/2)$.

Let $\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a typed graph on $(V,W,\pi)$,
where $|V|=n$ and $\omega_Wn\le|W|\le n$, with disjoint spoke types
and injective rim physical map \eqref{eq:physical:image-map}.
Put $R=R^0\dot\cup R^K$, $H=H^0\dot\cup H^K$ and
$\mathcal W(\mathcal Q)=\mathcal W_c^K(\mathcal Q;b,\pi)$.
Let $\varsigma_0,\varsigma_K\in[p_*,1]$ and $D_{\rm exc}\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$.
Assume that $(\mathcal Q,(\varsigma_j))$ has $(b,\pi)$-separated marked host
estimates at degree $D\in[n/2,2n]$ and rim density $p$, with errors
$(\varepsilon_0,\delta_0)$, extension coefficient $2\beta$, rim bounds
$(2\alpha p^2,\delta_c,2h_c)$ and exception bound $D_{\rm exc}$,
where $\delta_c,h_c$ are given by \eqref{eq:capacity:cuts}.
Let $\omega_0:\mathcal W(\mathcal Q)\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ satisfy
\begin{equation}
 b_-n^{1-c}\le\omega_0(W')\le b_+n^{1-c}
 \quad(W'\in\mathcal W(\mathcal Q)),\qquad
 |L_{\omega_0}(e)-1|\le\eta_0\quad(e\in\mathcal E(R,H)).
 \label{eq:packing:marked-initial-weights}
\end{equation}
Assume
\[
 D_{\rm exc}/n+1/|W|\le\delta_0,
\]
and that $D_{R^0},D_{R^K},H^0,H^K$ satisfy the
$(\delta_c',h_c')$ large-cut condition \eqref{eq:cuts:large}.
Let the four degree differences be those of \eqref{eq:typed:imbalance},
and suppose
\[
 |a^+(v)|,|a^-(v)|,|a^K(v)|\le\eta n\quad(v\in V),\qquad
 |a^W(w)|\le\eta n\quad(w\in W).
\]
Then there is a physical-edge-disjoint packing
$\mathcal P\subseteq\mathcal W(\mathcal Q)$ whose remainder
$L=\mathcal Q-\bigcup_{W'\in\mathcal P}E(W')$ satisfies
\begin{equation}
 \Delta_{\rm aux}(L)\le\gamma n,\qquad
 \Delta_{\rm phys}(L)\le\gamma n.
 \label{eq:packing:marked-output}
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: clm:marked-packing:inheritance
statements.title: Spoke intersections and cuts after deletion
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{localclaim}[Spoke intersections and cuts after deletion]
\label{clm:marked-packing:inheritance}
For $j\in\{0,K\}$, distinct $u_1,\ldots,u_k\in W$, $1\le k\le3$,
and $x,y\in V$,
\[
\begin{aligned}
0&\le n^{-1}\left(\left|\bigcap_{i=1}^kN_{H^j}(u_i)\right|
 -\left|\bigcap_{i=1}^kN_{(H^j)^-}(u_i)\right|\right)\le3t,\\
0&\le\frac{|N_{H^j}(x)\cap N_{H^j}(y)|
 -|N_{(H^j)^-}(x)\cap N_{(H^j)^-}(y)|}{\varsigma_j^2|W|}
 \le\frac{2t}{\omega_Wp_*^2}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus \ref{item:mw:spokes} holds in $\mathcal Q^-$ with error
$\delta_0+C_{\rm sp}t$, the same targets $\varsigma_j$, and unchanged exception sets.
If one of $D_{R^0},D_{R^K},H^0,H^K$ satisfies the
$(\delta_{\rm cut},h_{\rm cut})$ large-cut condition, then its remaining
graph satisfies the $(\delta_{\rm cut},h_{\rm cut}-t/\omega_W)$ condition,
provided $0\le\delta_{\rm cut}<1/4$ and $h_{\rm cut}>t/\omega_W$.
\end{localclaim}

statements.label: lem:new:bounded-degree-selection
statements.title: Selection with a fixed degree bound
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Selection with a fixed degree bound]
\label{lem:new:bounded-degree-selection}
Let $D_0\ge1$ be an integer, and let $p>0$.
There is $n_0=n_0(D_0,p)$ such that the following holds for all integers $n\ge n_0$ and $N\ge0$.
Let $G$ be an $n$-vertex graph, let $S_1,\ldots,S_N\subseteq V(G)$, and put
$t=\lceil4p^{3/2}n\rceil$. Suppose
\[
 |S_i\cap S_j|\le p^2n\quad(i\ne j),\qquad
 |\{i\in[N]:v\in S_i\}|\le pn\quad(v\in V(G)).
\]
For every $i\in[N]$, let $\mathcal F_i$ be a family of subgraphs of $G[S_i]$.
Suppose that for every $J\subseteq G[S_i]$ with $\Delta(J)\le D_0p^{3/2}n$,
there are $t$ edge-disjoint members of $\mathcal F_i$ in $G[S_i]-J$,
each of maximum degree at most $D_0$.
Then there are pairwise edge-disjoint $F_i\in\mathcal F_i$ with
$\Delta(\bigcup_{i=1}^NF_i)\le D_0pn$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:four:transformer
statements.title: A transformer with prescribed roots
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[A transformer with prescribed roots]
\label{lem:four:transformer}
Let $r\ge4$ be an integer, and let $\beta>0$.
There is $\epsilon_0=\epsilon_0(r,\beta)>0$ such that, for every nonnegative integer $q$,
there exist $K,n_0\in\mathbb N$, depending only on $r,\beta,q$, for which the following holds.
Let $n\ge n_0$, and let $\mathcal G=(V,U,G,H)$ be an extended graph with
$|V|=n$, $|U|\ge K$, $\delta(G)\ge(\nu_r+\beta)n$ and $H$ $\epsilon_0$-nearly-complete.
Let $L,L'\subseteq\mathcal G$ be vertex-disjoint extended graphs with at most $q$ vertices each,
and let $Z\subseteq V\dot\cup U$ satisfy $|Z|\le q$.
Suppose $L$ is $r$-wheel-divisible and
$\phi:L\to L'$ is a part-preserving edge-bijective homomorphism.
Then there is an extended subgraph $T\subseteq\mathcal G$ with $|V(T)|\le K$ such that
$L\cup T$ and $L'\cup T$ have $r$-wheel decompositions,
\[
 E\bigl(T[V(L)\cup V(L')]\bigr)=\varnothing,\qquad
 \bigl(V(T)\setminus(V(L)\cup V(L'))\bigr)\cap Z=\varnothing.
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: thm:four:absorber
statements.title: Bounded ordinary $r$-wheel absorber
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{theorem}[Bounded ordinary $r$-wheel absorber]
\label{thm:four:absorber}
Let $r\ge4$ be an integer, and let $\beta>0$.
There is $\epsilon_0=\epsilon_0(r,\beta)>0$ such that, for every nonnegative integer $m$,
there exist $M,n_0\in\mathbb N$, depending only on $r,\beta,m$, for which the following holds.
Let $n\ge n_0$, and let $\mathcal G=(V,U,G,H)$ be an extended graph with
$|V|=n$, $|U|\ge M$, $\delta(G)\ge(\nu_r+\beta)n$ and $H$ $\epsilon_0$-nearly-complete.
Let $L\subseteq\mathcal G$ be an $r$-wheel-divisible extended graph with $|V(L)|\le m$.
Then there is an extended subgraph $A_L\subseteq\mathcal G$ with $|V(A_L)|\le M$ such that
\[
 E(A_L[V(L)])=\varnothing,
\]
and both $A_L$ and $A_L\cup L$ have $r$-wheel decompositions.
\end{theorem}

statements.label: lem:new:triangle-transformer-explicit
statements.title: An indexed transformer for triangular wheels
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[An indexed transformer for triangular wheels]
\label{lem:new:triangle-transformer-explicit}
Let $\beta>0$.
There is $\epsilon_0=\epsilon_0(\beta)>0$ such that, for every nonnegative integer $q$,
there exist $K,n_0\in\mathbb N$, depending only on $\beta,q$, for which the following holds.
Let $n\ge n_0$, and let $\mathcal G=(V,U,G,H)$ be an extended graph with
$|V|=n$, $|U|\ge K$, $\delta(G)\ge(3/4+\beta)n$ and $H$ $\epsilon_0$-nearly-complete.
Let $L,L'\subseteq\mathcal G$ be vertex-disjoint extended graphs with at most $q$ vertices each,
and let $Z\subseteq V\dot\cup U$ satisfy $|Z|\le q$.
Suppose $L$ is $3$-wheel-divisible and
$\phi:L\to L'$ is a part-preserving edge-bijective homomorphism.
Then there is an extended subgraph $T\subseteq\mathcal G$ with $|V(T)|\le K$ such that
$L\cup T$ and $L'\cup T$ have $3$-wheel decompositions,
\[
 E\bigl(T[V(L)\cup V(L')]\bigr)=\varnothing,\qquad
 \bigl(V(T)\setminus(V(L)\cup V(L'))\bigr)\cap Z=\varnothing.
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:triangle-absorber
statements.title: Triangular-wheel absorbers
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Triangular-wheel absorbers]
\label{lem:new:triangle-absorber}
Let $m,M,n\in\mathbb N$ and $0<\varepsilon,\beta\le1$ satisfy
\[
 \varepsilon\ll\beta,\qquad 1/M\ll1/m,\beta,\qquad
 1/n\ll1/M,\beta.
\]
Let $\mathcal G=(V,U,G,H)$ be an extended graph with $|V|=n$, $|U|\ge M$ and
\[
 \delta(G)\ge(3/4+\beta)n,\qquad
 d_H(v)\ge(1-\varepsilon)|U|\ (v\in V),\qquad
 d_H(u)\ge(1-\varepsilon)n\ (u\in U).
\]
Let $L\subseteq\mathcal G$ be a $3$-wheel-divisible extended graph with $|V(L)|\le m$.
Then there is an extended subgraph $A_L\subseteq\mathcal G$ with $|V(A_L)|\le M$
such that $E(A_L[V(L)])=\varnothing$ and both $A_L$ and $A_L\cup L$
have $3$-wheel decompositions.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: def:class-profile:data
statements.title: Absorber templates with prescribed class sizes
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Absorber templates with prescribed class sizes]
\label{def:class-profile:data}
Let $s,a_1,\ldots,a_s$ be positive integers, and put
$c=\sum_i a_i\ge3$, $h=c^2$ and $R=[h+c]\setminus[h]$.
An \emph{absorber template with class sizes $(a_1,\ldots,a_s)$}
is a triple $T=(\kappa_T,\mathcal M_0^T,\mathcal M_1^T)$, where
$\kappa_T:[h+c]\to[s]$ is a class map and
$\mathcal M_0^T,\mathcal M_1^T$ are cycle factors on $[h],[h+c]$,
respectively, such that
\[
 |V(D)\cap\kappa_T^{-1}(i)|=a_i
 \quad(i\in[s],\ D\in\mathcal M_0^T\cup\mathcal M_1^T),
 \qquad |V(D)\cap R|\le1\quad(D\in\mathcal M_1^T).
\]
Write $R_T=R$. Any prescribed directions and edge types are part of $T$.
\end{definition}

statements.label: def:cycle:weight-absorber-estimates
statements.title: Cycle weight and absorber estimates
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Cycle weight and absorber estimates]
\label{def:cycle:weight-absorber-estimates}
Let $V_1,\ldots,V_s$ be disjoint finite sets, let $a_1,\ldots,a_s$
be positive integers with $c=\sum_i a_i\ge3$, and let $\mathcal C$
be a finite indexed family of $c$-cycles on $\bigcup_iV_i$, each meeting $V_i$ in $a_i$ vertices.
Put $\mathbf a=(a_1,\ldots,a_s)$ and fix a finite family
$\mathcal T$ of absorber templates with these class sizes. Let $m,a_{\rm abs},b_-,b_+>0$ and $\eta\ge0$.
A weighting $\phi:\mathcal C\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ has
\emph{cycle weight and absorber estimates at scale $m$}, with
error $\eta$, coefficient bounds $(b_-,b_+)$ and absorber coefficient
$a_{\rm abs}$, for $\mathcal T$, if
\begin{align}
 b_-m^{1-c}\le\phi(C)&\le b_+m^{1-c} &&(C\in\mathcal C),
 \label{eq:cycle:weight-bounds}\\
 \left|\sum_{C\in\mathcal C:v\in V(C)}\phi(C)-1\right|&\le\eta
 &&(v\in\textstyle\bigcup_iV_i),
 \label{eq:cycle:vertex-loads}\\
 |\mathcal A_{\mathcal C}^{\mathcal T}(X)|&\ge a_{\rm abs}m^{c^2}
 &&(X\in\mathcal R_{\mathbf a}).
 \label{eq:cycle:absorber-estimates}
\end{align}
The scale $m$ is a positive real number; it need not equal a class size.
\end{definition}

statements.label: lem:simp:profile-marginals
statements.title: Correction of vertex sums
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Correction of vertex sums]
\label{lem:simp:profile-marginals}
Fix an integer $s\ge1$ and positive integers $a_1,\ldots,a_s$, put $c=\sum_i a_i\ge3$ and $h=c^2$,
and fix $J\ge1$ and a finite family $\mathcal T$ of absorber templates
with class sizes $(a_1,\ldots,a_s)$.
Fix $a,b,B>0$. There are $\eta_0>0$ and $k_0>1$ such that
the following holds for every real $k\ge k_0$ with all $a_i k$ integral.
Let $V_1,\ldots,V_s$ be disjoint sets with $|V_i|=a_i k$, and let
$\mathcal C$ be a finite indexed family of cycles with
$|V(C)\cap V_i|=a_i$ for every $C\in\mathcal C$ and $i\in[s]$.
Suppose at most $J$ members of $\mathcal C$ have any given vertex set.
Let $0\le\eta\le\eta_0$ and let $\phi$ have cycle weight and absorber
estimates at scale $k$, with error $\eta$, coefficient bounds $(b,B)$
and absorber coefficient $a$, for $\mathcal T$.
Then there is $\psi:\mathcal C\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ satisfying
\[
 \sum_{C\in\mathcal C:v\in V(C)}\psi(C)=1\quad(v\in\bigcup_iV_i),\qquad
 (b/2)k^{1-c}\le\psi(C)\le(B+b/2)k^{1-c}
       \quad(C\in\mathcal C).
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:simp:profile-factor
statements.title: Factor extraction with prescribed class sizes
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Factor extraction with prescribed class sizes]
\label{lem:simp:profile-factor}
Fix an integer $s\ge1$ and positive integers $a_1,\ldots,a_s$, put $c=\sum_i a_i\ge3$ and $h=c^2$,
and fix $J\ge1$ and a finite family $\mathcal T$ of absorber templates
with class sizes $(a_1,\ldots,a_s)$.
Fix $a,b,B>0$. There exist $\eta_*>0$ and an integer $k_0$
such that the following holds for every integer $k\ge k_0$.
Let $V_1,\ldots,V_s$ be disjoint sets with $|V_i|=a_i k$, and let
$\mathcal C$ be a finite indexed family of cycles with
$|V(C)\cap V_i|=a_i$ for every $C\in\mathcal C$ and $i\in[s]$.
Suppose at most $J$ members of $\mathcal C$ have any given vertex set.
Let $\phi$ have cycle weight and absorber estimates at scale $k$,
with error $\eta_*$, coefficient bounds $(b,B)$ and absorber
coefficient $a$, for $\mathcal T$.
Then there is a factor $\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal C$
on $\bigcup_iV_i$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: thm:simp:profile-finite-cleanup
statements.title: Two bounded factors with prescribed class sizes
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{theorem}[Two bounded factors with prescribed class sizes]
\label{thm:simp:profile-finite-cleanup}
Fix an integer $s\ge1$ and positive integers $a_1,\ldots,a_s$, put $c=\sum_i a_i\ge3$ and $h=c^2$,
and fix $J\ge1$ and a finite family $\mathcal T$ of absorber templates
with class sizes $(a_1,\ldots,a_s)$.
Fix
$a,b,B>0$. There exists $\eta>0$ such that, for every integer
$q\ge0$, there is an integer $t\ge1$ such that, for every
$F_0,D_0\ge0$, there is $k_0>1$ with the following property.

Let $k\ge k_0$ be real with all $a_i k$ integral, and let
$V_1,\ldots,V_s$ be disjoint sets with $|V_i|=a_i k$. Let
$\mathcal C$ be a finite indexed family of cycles with
$|V(C)\cap V_i|=a_i$ for every $C\in\mathcal C$ and $i\in[s]$,
with at most $J$ members having any given vertex set. Let
$\phi:\mathcal C\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$, let
$T\subseteq\bigcup_iV_i$ have $|T|\le F_0$, and let $J_0$
be a simple graph on $\bigcup_iV_i$ with $\Delta(J_0)\le D_0$.

Suppose $\phi$ has cycle weight and absorber estimates at scale $k$,
with error $\eta$, coefficient bounds $(b,B)$ and absorber coefficient
$a$, for $\mathcal T$.

Let $Z\subseteq\bigcup_iV_i$ satisfy $|Z\cap V_i|=a_i z$
for every $i\in[s]$, where $z$ is an integer with $0\le z\le q$.
Then there exist $S\subseteq(\bigcup_iV_i)\setminus(Z\cup T)$ and
edge-disjoint factors $D^0,D^1\subseteq\mathcal C$ on $S,S\cup Z$, respectively,
such that
\[
 |S\cap V_i|=a_it\quad(i\in[s]),\qquad E(J_0[S])=\varnothing,
 \qquad |V(C)\cap Z|\le1\quad(C\in D^1).
\]
\end{theorem}

statements.label: lem:new:bernoulli-factor
statements.title: Factors after independent vertex sampling
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Factors after independent vertex sampling]
\label{lem:new:bernoulli-factor}
Let $a,b,B,J>0$ and let $c\ge3$ be an integer.
There are $\eta_0,\zeta>0$ such that, for every $\rho\in(0,1)$,
there is $k_0$
for which the following holds for $k\ge k_0$.
Let $\mathcal C$ be a finite indexed family of $c$-cycles on $U$,
in one of the following two cases.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item $|U|=k$. Use a fixed finite family $\mathcal T$ of one-class
absorber templates with class size $c$.
\item $U=A\dot\cup B_1$, $|A|=k$,
$(c-1)k/2\le|B_1|\le2(c-1)k$, and each cycle meets $A$ once.
Use paired absorbers on $(A,B_1)$.
\end{enumerate}
All absorber embeddings preserve the prescribed directions and types.
Suppose at most $J$ cycles have any given vertex set. Let $\phi$ have
cycle weight and absorber estimates at scale $k$, with error $\eta_0$,
coefficient bounds $(b,B)$ and absorber coefficient $a$, using the
absorbers specified in \textup{(i)} or \textup{(ii)}.
Include each vertex of $U$ independently in $U'$ with probability $\rho$.
Except on an event of probability at most $k^{-10}$,
every $U''\subseteq U$ with $|U''\triangle U'|\le\zeta\rho k$ and
every graph $F$ on $V_{\rm phys}$ with $\Delta(F)\le\zeta\rho k$
admit a factor from $\mathcal C$ on $U''$ avoiding $F$ in its physical edges,
provided $c\mid|U''|$ in \textup{(i)}, or
$|U''\cap B_1|=(c-1)|U''\cap A|$ in \textup{(ii)}.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: def:common:ordinary-weights
statements.title: Common ordinary cycle weights and absorber counts
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Common ordinary cycle weights and absorber counts]
\label{def:common:ordinary-weights}
Let $r\ge3$, $d\ge2$, $\eta\ge0$ and $\beta,a_*,b_-,b_+>0$.
Let $R$ be a graph on $V$, $|V|=n$, let $H$ be bipartite on
disjoint sets $V,U$, and let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$.
The host $(R,H)$ has common ordinary cycle weights and absorber counts relative to $\pi$ with parameters
$(r,d,\eta,\beta,a_*,b_-,b_+)$ if the following holds.
For all distinct $u,u'\in U$, put
\[
 T_{u,u'}=N_H(u)\cap N_H(u')
\]
and let $\mathcal C_{u,u'}$ be the family of
$(3d,\pi)$-separated $r$-cycles in $R[T_{u,u'}]$.
There is a function
$\phi_{u,u'}:\mathcal C_{u,u'}\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ such that
\[
 |T_{u,u'}|\ge\beta n,
\qquad
 b_-n^{1-r}\le\phi_{u,u'}(C)\le b_+n^{1-r}
 \quad(C\in\mathcal C_{u,u'}),
\]
\[
 \left|\sum_{\substack{C\in\mathcal C_{u,u'}\\v\in V(C)}}
                  \phi_{u,u'}(C)-1\right|\le\eta
 \quad(v\in T_{u,u'}),
\]
and the common cycle family also satisfies
\[
 |\mathcal A_{\mathcal C_{u,u'}}^{\mathfrak T_r}(X)|
      \ge a_*n^{r^2}\qquad(X\in\tbinom{T_{u,u'}}r).
\]
Here $\mathfrak T_r$ is the family of ordinary $r$-cycle absorber templates.
\end{definition}

statements.label: thm:new:ordinary-relative-absorber
statements.title: Bounded ordinary absorbers in a pseudorandom wheel host
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{theorem}[Bounded ordinary absorbers in a pseudorandom wheel host]
\label{thm:new:ordinary-relative-absorber}
Fix an integer $r\ge3$ and constants
$\omega,\beta,a_*,b_-,b_+>0$.
There exist $\eta,\epsilon_*>0$ such that, for every integer $d\ge2$
and every integer $m_0\ge0$, there is $M\in\mathbb N$ with the following
property.  For every integer $f\ge0$ there is $n_0\in\mathbb N$ such
that the following holds for $n\ge n_0$.

Let $V,U$ be disjoint sets, let $|V|=n$ and
$\omega n\le |U|\le n$, let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$, let
$R$ be a graph on $V$ with
$E(R)\subseteq\{xy\in\binom V2:\operatorname{dist}_\pi(x,y)>3d\}$,
and let $H$ be a bipartite graph on $V,U$.
Put $k_3=4$, $k_4=3$ and $k_r=2$ for $r\ge5$.
Assume the following.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item\label{item:ordinary-relative-absorber:row}
For every $S\subseteq V$ and $J\subseteq U$ with
$|S|\le k_r$ and $|J|\le2$,
\[
 |N_R(S)\cap N_H(J)|\ge\beta n.
\]
\item\label{item:ordinary-relative-absorber:hub}
For every $(3d,\pi)$-separated set $T\subseteq V$ with
$|T|\le r+6$,
\[
 |N_H(T)|\ge\beta n.
\]
\item\label{item:ordinary-relative-absorber:common}
The host $(R,H)$ has common ordinary cycle weights and absorber counts relative to $\pi$ with parameters
$(r,d,\eta,\beta,a_*,b_-,b_+)$.
\end{enumerate}

Let $L\subseteq(R,H)$ be $r$-wheel-divisible, with
$|V(L)|\le m_0$.  Let $I_V\subseteq V$ and $I_U\subseteq U$ satisfy
$|I_V|,|I_U|\le\epsilon_*n$.  Let
$I_0\subseteq(V\dot\cup U)\setminus V(L)$ and
$F_0\subseteq\binom{V\cup U}{2}$ satisfy
$|I_0|+|F_0|\le f$.
Then there is $A_L\subseteq(R,H)$ such that, with
$N_L=V(A_L)\setminus V(L)$,
\[
 |N_L|\le M,\qquad
 N_L\cap(I_V\cup I_U\cup I_0)=\varnothing,
\]
\[
 E(A_L)\cap(E(L)\cup F_0)=\varnothing,\qquad
 E(A_L[V(L)])=\varnothing.
\]
Both $A_L$ and $A_L\cup L$ have ordinary $r$-wheel decompositions.
\end{theorem}

statements.label: lem:local:marked-hub-absorbers
statements.title: Absorbers from cycles and common paths at one hub
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Absorbers from cycles and common paths at one hub]
\label{lem:local:marked-hub-absorbers}
Let $c\ge8$ be an integer and let $\beta>0$. There exists $a>0$ such that for every
integer $b\ge1$ there is $n_0\in\mathbb N$ for which the following holds
for $n\ge n_0$.
Let $V,W$ be disjoint sets and let $\pi$ be a successor permutation of $V$.
Let $\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a physically injective typed
graph on $(V,W,\pi)$, with $|V|=n$, and let $w\in W$.
Put $Y=N_{H^{K}_{\mathcal Q}}(w)$ and
$O=N_{H^{0}_{\mathcal Q}}(w)$, and assume $|Y|,|O|\ge\beta n$.
Let $\mathcal C_w$ and $\mathcal F_j(v,v';w)$ be defined by
\eqref{eq:marked:one-hub-cycles} and \eqref{eq:marked:one-hub-paths}, respectively.
Suppose $|\mathcal C_w|\ge\beta n^c$ and
\[
 |\mathcal F_K(v,v';w)|\ge\beta n^{c-1}\quad(v\ne v'\in Y),\qquad
 |\mathcal F_0(v,v';w)|\ge\beta n^{c-1}\quad(v\ne v'\in O).
\]
Then $|\mathcal A_{\mathcal C_w}(X)|\ge an^{c^2}$ for every
$X\in\mathcal R_{c-1}(Y,O)$, with the families of
\eqref{eq:roots:two-classes} and the paired-absorber construction \eqref{eq:cycle:paired-absorbers}. 
\end{lemma}

statements.title: Two compatible endpoint matchings
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Two compatible endpoint matchings]
\label{lem:four:typed-pairing}
Fix integers $b,M\ge1$, positive $\kappa,\lambda$, and
$0<\epsilon<\min\{\kappa,\lambda\}/8$.
There is $s_0\in\mathbb N$ such that the following holds for
integers $s\ge s_0$.
Let $A=A_K\dot\cup A_0$, $X=X_K\dot\cup X_0$ and
$Y=Y_K\dot\cup Y_0$ be finite index sets of size $s$, with
\[
 |A_K|=|Y_K|=k,\qquad |X_K|=l,\qquad k+l\le(1-\kappa)s.
\]
The three index sets are taken as disjoint copies.
Let $\pi$ be a permutation of a finite set $V$, and let
$\ell_A:A\to V$, $\ell_X:X\to V$ satisfy
$|\ell_A^{-1}(v)|,|\ell_X^{-1}(v)|\le M$ for $v\in V$.
Let $B_1,\ldots,B_5$ be bipartite graphs on the ordered pairs
\[
 (A_K,Y_K),\quad(A_0,Y_0),\quad(X_K,Y_0),\quad
 (X_0,Y_0),\quad(X_0,Y_K),
\]
respectively. For each graph $B_i$ on $(P_i,Q_i)$ suppose that
\[
\begin{gathered}
 d_{B_i}(z)\ge2\lambda s\quad(z\in P_i\cup Q_i),\\
 e_{B_i}(P,Q)\ge\lambda|P||Q|
 \quad(P\subseteq P_i,\ Q\subseteq Q_i,\ |P|,|Q|\ge\epsilon s).
\end{gathered}
\]
Then there exist bijections $f:A\to Y$ and $g:X\to Y$ such that
\[
\begin{gathered}
 (a,f(a))\in E(B_1)\cup E(B_2)\quad(a\in A),\\
 (a,g(a))\in E(B_3)\cup E(B_4)\cup E(B_5)\quad(a\in X),\\
 f(A_K)=Y_K,\qquad g(X_K)\subseteq Y_0,\\
 \operatorname{dist}_\pi\bigl(\ell_A(f^{-1}(y)),
                              \ell_X(g^{-1}(y))\bigr)>b\quad(y\in Y).
\end{gathered}
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: thm:new:fresh-candidacy
statements.title: Degree and cut bounds after random restriction
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{theorem}[Degree and cut bounds after random restriction]
\label{thm:new:fresh-candidacy}
Fix $0<p_*,a\le1$ and $\epsilon>0$.
There are $\eta_0,\zeta>0$ such that, for every integer $b\ge0$
and every $\rho\in(0,1)$, there is $N_0\in\mathbb N$ with the following property.
Let $D$ be a bipartite graph on $(A,B)$, with
$aN\le m=|A|,n=|B|\le N$, $N\ge N_0$, and $p\in[p_*,1]$.
Suppose
\[
 d_D(x)=(p\pm\eta_0)n\quad(x\in A),\qquad
 d_D(y)=(p\pm\eta_0)m\quad(y\in B).
\]
Let $J$ be the graph on $A$ in which distinct $x,x'$ are adjacent
precisely when
\[
 |N_D(x)\cap N_D(x')|>(p^2+\eta_0)n.
\]
Assume
\begin{equation}
 \Delta(J)\le b.
 \label{eq:new:fresh-endpoint-candidacy:E2}
\end{equation}
Put $m'=\lfloor\rho m\rfloor$, $n'=\lfloor\rho n\rfloor$ and
$s_R=\min\{m',n'\}$. Form $A'\subseteq A$ and $B'\subseteq B$
by including each vertex of $A\cup B$ independently with probability $\rho$.
With probability at least $1-N^{-10}$, the following holds
simultaneously for every $A''\subseteq A$, $B''\subseteq B$ with
\begin{equation}
 |A''\triangle A'|+|B''\triangle B'|\le\zeta s_R
 \label{eq:new:fresh-endpoint-candidacy:E3}
\end{equation}
and every $F\subseteq D[A'',B'']$ with $\Delta(F)\le\zeta s_R$.
The graph $D''=D[A'',B'']-F$ satisfies
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item $d_{D''}(x)\ge(p_*/2)|B''|$ for $x\in A''$, and
$d_{D''}(y)\ge(p_*/2)|A''|$ for $y\in B''$;
\item $e_{D''}(P,Q)\ge(p_*/2)|P||Q|$ whenever
$P\subseteq A''$, $Q\subseteq B''$, $|P|\ge\epsilon|A''|$ and
$|Q|\ge\epsilon|B''|$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}

statements.label: lem:new:marked-endpoint-counts
statements.title: Marked endpoint graph estimates
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Marked endpoint graph estimates]
\label{lem:new:marked-endpoint-counts}
Fix $\kappa,p_*>0$ and an integer $c\ge8$.
There are $C,a_0,e_0>0$ such that the following holds for every
$d\ge0$ and $\varepsilon,\delta\ge0$.
Let $V,U$ be disjoint finite sets, let $P$ be a simple graph on $V$,
and let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$.
Let $A\subseteq V$, $B\subseteq U$, with $a=|A|>0$,
$\kappa a\le b=|B|\le a$ and $\pi(A)=A$.
Let $\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be physically injective, with
$R^j\subseteq\overline R^j$, and satisfy
the row bounds \eqref{eq:cn:marked-V} for
\[
 T_j^\pm=\varnothing,\qquad
 \sum_{j\in\{0,K\}}(|S_j^+|+|S_j^-|)\le1,\qquad |J_0|+|J_K|\le1,
\]
and the index bounds \eqref{eq:cn:marked-U} for $|S_0|+|S_K|\le3$,
on $(A,B)$ with $S_j^\pm,S_0,S_K\subseteq V$ and $J_0,J_K\subseteq U$,
error $\varepsilon$, and constant
densities $(p_0,p_K,s_0,s_K)=(p,k,s,t)$, eligible arc sets
$E_j(P,\pi,3d)$ and exception graph $F_{\pi,3d}$.
Suppose
\[
\begin{gathered}
 p,k,s,t\in[p_*,1],\qquad p=(c-1)k,\qquad s=(c-1)t,\\
 kD_A=tb,\qquad a/2\le D_A\le2a,\qquad
 |d_P(v;A)-D_A|\le\delta a\quad(v\in V).
\end{gathered}
\]
For each $x\in V$, use the marked endpoint assignment graphs on
$(A,B)$ (Definition~\ref{def:endpoints:assignment-graphs}), with
parts $P_{x,i},Q_{x,i}$ and larger row domains $\overline P_{x,i}$.
Put $e=C(\varepsilon+\delta+(d+1)/a)$.
Then, for every $x\in V$ and $i\in[5]$,
the enlarged domains satisfy
\[
\begin{aligned}
 \bigl||\mathcal N_{x,i}(a')|-z_i|Q_{x,i}|\bigr|&\le e|Q_{x,i}|
                    &&(a'\in\overline P_{x,i}),\\
 \bigl||\mathcal M_{x,i}(u)|-z_i|P_{x,i}|\bigr|&\le e|P_{x,i}|
                    &&(u\in B),\\
 |\mathcal N_{x,i}(a')\cap\mathcal N_{x,i}(a'')|
       &\le(z_i^2+e)|Q_{x,i}|
                    &&\begin{gathered}(a',a''\in\overline P_{x,i},\\
                 a''\notin\mathcal E_{x,i}(a')\cup\{a'\}),\end{gathered}\\
 |\mathcal E_{x,i}(a')|&\le6d+1&& (a'\in\overline P_{x,i}).
\end{aligned}
\]
If $e\le e_0$, then $|P_{x,i}|,|Q_{x,i}|\ge a_0a$ and, writing
$k_x=|A_K(x)|$, $l_x=|X_K(x)|$, $s_x=|Y_0(x)|+|Y_K(x)|$,
\begin{equation}
 k_x+l_x\le 3s_x/c\le s_x/2.
 \label{eq:endpoints:marked-ratio}
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:pr:ordinary-endpoints
statements.title: Assigning pairs of neighbours
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Assigning pairs of neighbours]
\label{lem:pr:ordinary-endpoints}
Let $0<\lambda\le1$ and put $\varepsilon=\lambda/16$.
For every integer $b_0\ge1$ and all sufficiently large $m$, the
following holds. Let $D$ be bipartite with parts $S,T$, where
$|S|=2m$ and $|T|=m$, and let $B_0$ be a graph on $S$ with
$\Delta(B_0)\le b_0$. Suppose
\[
 d_D(v)\ge\lambda m\quad(v\in S),\qquad
 d_D(u)\ge2\lambda m\quad(u\in T),
\]
and
\[
 e_D(X,Y)\ge\lambda|X||Y|
 \quad(X\subseteq S,\ Y\subseteq T,\ |X|,|Y|\ge\varepsilon m).
\]
Then $S$ has a partition $\dot\bigcup_{u\in T}\{v_u,w_u\}$ with
$uv_u,uw_u\in E(D)$ and $v_uw_u\notin E(B_0)$ for every $u\in T$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:ordinary-local-factor
statements.title: Cycle factors in one or two common neighbourhoods
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Cycle factors in one or two common neighbourhoods]
\label{lem:completion:ordinary-local-factor}
Fix $r\ge3$ and $\alpha,p_*,c_-,c_+>0$. There exist
$b_-,b_+,a_*,C,\varepsilon_0,\eta_{\rm fac}>0$ and $a_0\in\mathbb N$
such that the following holds for $0\le\varepsilon\le\varepsilon_0$.
Let $A,J$ be disjoint finite sets with $|A|=a\ge a_0$ and
$|J|=j\in\{1,2\}$. Let $\delta,\xi\ge0$, $q\in[p_*,1]$,
$s\in[p_*,1]$ and $a/2\le D_A\le2a$.

Let $P[A]$ have minimum degree at least
$(\delta_{C_r}+\alpha)a$ and
$|d_P(v;A)-D_A|\le\delta a$ for $v\in A$.

Suppose $\lambda$ is an exact fractional $C_r$-decomposition of
$P[A]$ with $c_-a^{2-r}\le\lambda(C)\le c_+a^{2-r}$.
Let $F$ be a graph on $A$, put $P^{\rm adm}=P[A]-E(F)$, and let
$Q\subseteq P^{\rm adm}$ and $H$ be bipartite on $(A,J)$.
Put $T_J=A\cap N_H(J)$. Suppose
\begin{equation}
 |T_J\cap N_Q(S)|
 \ge q^{|S|}s^j|A\cap N_{P^{\rm adm}}(S)|-\varepsilon a
 \quad(S\subseteq A,\ |S|\le h_r),
 \label{eq:local:factor-neighbourhoods}
\end{equation}
where $h_3=3$ and $h_r=2$ for $r\ge4$.

Assume $\Delta(F)\le\varepsilon_0a$ and
\begin{equation}
 |Z_{v,J}-\ell_v|\le\xi\qquad(v\in A).
 \label{eq:neighbourhood:root-load-error}
\end{equation}
Then $\phi_J|_{\mathcal C_J}$ has cycle weight and absorber estimates
on $T_J$ at scale $a$, with error $C(\delta+\Delta(F)/a)+\xi$,
coefficient bounds $(b_-,b_+)$ and absorber coefficient $a_*$,
for the ordinary template family $\mathfrak T_r$.
If $r\mid|T_J|$ and $C(\delta+\Delta(F)/a)+\xi\le\eta_{\rm fac}$,
there is a factor $\mathcal P_J\subseteq\mathcal C_J$ of $T_J$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:marked-hub-factor
statements.title: A marked cycle factor at one hub
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[A marked cycle factor at one hub]
\label{lem:completion:marked-hub-factor}
Fix an integer $c\ge8$ and $\beta,b_-,b_+>0$. There exists $\eta_*>0$ such that for every fixed separation
distance $b\in\mathbb Z_{\ge1}$ there is $n_0\in\mathbb N$ for which the following holds
for $n\ge n_0$. Let $V,W$ be disjoint sets with $|V|=n$, let
$\pi$ be a permutation of $V$, and let
$\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a physically injective marked host
on $(V,W)$, using separation parameter $b$.

Let $w\in W$, $Y=N_{H^K}(w)$ and $O=N_{H^0}(w)$. Let $\mathcal C_w$
and $\mathcal F_j(v,v';w)$ be the families in
\eqref{eq:marked:one-hub-cycles} and \eqref{eq:marked:one-hub-paths}.
Assume
\[
\begin{gathered}
 |Y|,|O|\ge\beta n,\qquad |\mathcal C_w|\ge\beta n^c,\\
 |\mathcal F_K(v,v';w)|\ge\beta n^{c-1}\quad(v\ne v'\in Y),\qquad
 |\mathcal F_0(v,v';w)|\ge\beta n^{c-1}\quad(v\ne v'\in O),
\end{gathered}
\]
and
\begin{equation}
 |O|=(c-1)|Y|,\qquad O\cap\pi(Y)=\varnothing.
 \label{eq:new:marked-hub-factors:F11}
\end{equation}

Let $\phi:\mathcal C_w\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ satisfy
\[
 b_-n^{1-c}\le\phi(C)\le b_+n^{1-c},\qquad
 \left|\sum_{C\ni v}\phi(C)-1\right|\le\eta_*
                         \quad(v\in Y\cup O).
\]

Then there exists a factor $\mathcal P\subseteq\mathcal C_w$ of $Y\cup O$.
The wheels $\{W(C,w):C\in\mathcal P\}$ cover every spoke at $w$ once;
their physical rim edges are distinct. The graph
$G_w=(V,\bigcup_{C\in\mathcal P}E_{\rm phys}(C))$ satisfies $\Delta(G_w)\le2$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:triangle-endpoint-factor
statements.title: Weighted endpoint triangles and factors
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Weighted endpoint triangles and factors]
\label{lem:completion:triangle-endpoint-factor}
Fix $\alpha,\kappa,p_*,c_-,c_+>0$.
There are
\[
 C,b_-,b_+,a_*,\eta_{\rm fac},\varepsilon_0,\tau_0>0
\]
and $a_0\in\mathbb N$ such that the following holds for
$0<\varepsilon\le\varepsilon_0$ and $\delta,\xi\ge0$.

Let $A,B$ be disjoint sets, $a=|A|\ge a_0$, $b=|B|$, let
$x\notin B$, let $P,F$ be graphs on $A\cup\{x\}$,
$R\subseteq P-E(F)$ and $H\subseteq(A\cup\{x\})\times B$.

Put $P_x=N_P(x;A)$, $E_x=N_{P-E(F)}(x;A)$, $m_x=|P_x|$,
$S_x=N_R(x;A)$ and $T_x=N_H(x;B)$, and let
$\lambda_x:E(P[P_x])\to\mathbb R_{>0}$.

Assume $\Delta(F)\le\tau_0 a$.
Suppose $\kappa a\le b\le a$, $q,s\in[p_*,1]$,
\[
 \delta(P[A])\ge(3/4+\alpha)a,\qquad
 m_x\ge(3/4+\alpha)a,\qquad
 |qm_x/(2bs)-1|\le\delta.
\]

Assume $c_-/a\le\lambda_x(e)\le c_+/a$ and
$\sum_{e\ni v}\lambda_x(e)=1$ on $P[P_x]$.
Suppose
\begin{equation}
 |A\cap N_R(S)\cap N_H(J)|
 \ge q^{|S|}s^{|J|}|A\cap N_{P-E(F)}(S)|-\varepsilon a
 \label{eq:local:triangle-row-bounds}
\end{equation}
for $x\in S\subseteq A\cup\{x\}$, $J\subseteq B$ with
$|S|\le3$, $|J|\le2$ and $|S|+|J|\le4$. Suppose also
\begin{equation}
 |B\cap N_H(S)|\ge(s^{|S|}-\varepsilon)b
 \quad(x\in S\subseteq A\cup\{x\},\ |S|\in\{1,3\},\ E(F[S])=\varnothing).
 \label{eq:local:triangle-index-bounds}
\end{equation}

Let $Z_{x,v},Z_{x,u}$ and $m_{x,v},m_{x,u}$ be the loads and targets
of \eqref{eq:loads:triangular-endpoints}.
Assume $|Z_{x,v}-m_{x,v}|\le\xi$ for $v\in E_x$ and
$|Z_{x,u}-m_{x,u}|\le\xi$ for $u\in B$.
Then $\phi_x|_{\mathcal T_x}$ has cycle weight and absorber estimates
with paired absorbers on $(T_x,S_x)$ at scale $a$, with error
$\delta+C\Delta(F)/a+\xi$, coefficient bounds $(b_-,b_+)$ and
absorber coefficient $a_*$.
If, in addition,
\[
 |S_x|=2|T_x|,\qquad
 \delta+C\Delta(F)/a+\xi\le\eta_{\rm fac},
\]
then $\mathcal T_x$ contains a factor of $S_x\cup T_x$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:local-extensions
statements.title: Ordinary local extensions
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Ordinary local extensions]
\label{lem:completion:local-extensions}
Fix $\alpha>0$, $0<\varrho_*,s_*\le1$ and an integer $r\ge3$.
Put $\kappa=\varrho_*/8$.
There are $\beta_*,\varepsilon_0>0$ such that for every $d\ge2$
there is $a_0\in\mathbb N$ with the following property.
Let $0\le\varepsilon\le\varepsilon_0$, $\varrho\in[\varrho_*,1]$,
$s\in[s_*,1]$ and $a\ge a_0$.
Let $P$ be a graph on $V$ and let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$.
Put $F=F_{\pi,3d}$, the graph on $V$ joining distinct labels at
$\pi$-distance at most $3d$, and $P_{\rm el}=P-E(F)$.
Let $\mathcal Q=(R,H)$ be an ordinary host on $V,U$ with $R\subseteq P_{\rm el}$.
Let $A\subseteq V$, $B\subseteq U$ satisfy
$\pi(A)=A$, $|A|=a$, $|B|=b$ and $\kappa a\le b\le a$.
Put $q=\varrho s$, and let $k_3=4$, $k_4=3$ and $k_r=2$ for $r\ge5$.
Assume $d_P(v;A)\ge(\delta_{C_r}+\alpha)a$ for $v\in V$ and
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
 |A\cap N_R(S)\cap N_H(J)|
 &\ge q^{|S|}s^{|J|}|A\cap N_{P_{\rm el}}(S)|-\varepsilon a
 &&(|S|\le k_r,\ |J|\le2),\\
 |B\cap N_H(S)|&\ge(s^{|S|}-\varepsilon)b
 &&(|S|\le r+6,\ E(F[S])=\varnothing),
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:extensions:ordinary-input}
\end{equation}
for all $S\subseteq V$ and $J\subseteq U$ in the indicated ranges. Then
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item\label{item:extensions:ordinary-vertex}
For $S\subseteq V$, $J\subseteq U$ with $|S|\le k_r$ and $|J|\le2$,
\[
 |A\cap N_R(S)\cap N_H(J)|\ge\beta_*a,
\]
\item\label{item:extensions:ordinary-index}
For every $(3d,\pi)$-separated $S\subseteq V$ with $|S|\le r+6$,
\[
 |B\cap N_H(S)|\ge\beta_*b.
\]
\end{enumerate}

\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:marked-local-extensions
statements.title: Marked local extensions
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Marked local extensions]
\label{lem:completion:marked-local-extensions}
Fix $\alpha>0$, $0<\varrho_*,s_*\le1$ and an even integer $c\ge8$.
Put $\kappa=\varrho_*/8$.
There are $\beta_*,\varepsilon_0>0$ such that for every $d\ge2$
there is $a_0\in\mathbb N$ with the following property.
Let $0\le\varepsilon\le\varepsilon_0$, $\varrho\in[\varrho_*,1]$,
$s\in[s_*,1]$ and $a\ge a_0$.
Let $P$ be a graph on $V$ and let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$.
Let $\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a marked host on $V,U$
whose physical rim edges lie in $P$.
Let $F_{\pi,3d}$ be the graph on $V$ joining distinct labels at
$\pi$-distance at most $3d$.
Let $A\subseteq V$, $B\subseteq U$ satisfy
$\pi(A)=A$, $|A|=a$, $|B|=b$ and $\kappa a\le b\le a$.
Assume $d_P(v;A)\ge(1/2+\alpha)a$ for $v\in V$.
Use the probabilities \eqref{eq:family:marked-probabilities}, eligible
arc sets $E_0(P,\pi,3d),E_K(P,\pi,3d)$ and exception graph $F_{\pi,3d}$.
Assume $N_V^{\rm mark}(A;i)\ge\mu_V^{\rm mark}(A;i)-\varepsilon a$
for the four patterns defining $E_0,E_K,E_{00},E_{0K}$ in
\eqref{eq:inner:one-edge}--\eqref{eq:inner:two-edge-marked}:
all $v,w\in V$, $u\in U$, with $v\ne w$ for $E_{00}$ and
$v\ne\pi(w)$ for $E_{0K}$.
Assume also
\begin{equation}
 |B\cap N_{H^0}(S_0)\cap N_{H^K}(S_K)|
 \ge\bigl(s^{|S_0|}t^{|S_K|}-\varepsilon\bigr)b
 \label{eq:extensions:marked-index-input}
\end{equation}
for disjoint $S_0,S_K\subseteq V$ with $(3d,\pi)$-separated union
of size at most $c+6$. Then
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item\label{item:extensions:marked-vertex}
For $v,w\in V$ and $u\in U$,
\[
\begin{aligned}
 |E_j(v,u;A)|&\ge\beta_*a &&(j\in\{0,K\}),\\
 |E_{00}(v,w,u;A)|&\ge\beta_*a &&(v\ne w),\\
 |E_{0K}(v,w,u;A)|&\ge\beta_*a &&(v\ne\pi(w)).
\end{aligned}
\]
\item\label{item:extensions:marked-index}
For every disjoint $S_0,S_K\subseteq V$ whose union is
$(3d,\pi)$-separated and has size at most $c+6$,
\[
 |B\cap N_{H^0}(S_0)\cap N_{H^K}(S_K)|\ge\beta_*b.
\]
\end{enumerate}

\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:marked-estimate-changes
statements.title: Changes to marked cycle and wheel sums
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Changes to marked cycle and wheel sums]
\label{lem:completion:marked-estimate-changes}
Fix an even integer $c\ge8$ and $b_+>0$. There is a constant
$C_{\rm mark}=C_{\rm mark}(c,b_+)$ with the following property.
Let $P$ be a graph on $V$, let $U$ be disjoint from $V$, and fix
a permutation $\pi$ of $V$ and an integer $d\ge2$.
Let $A\subseteq V$ and $B\subseteq Y\subseteq U$, where
$a=|A|>0$, $\pi(A)=A$ and $0<|B|\le2a$.

Use the potential cycle family $\mathcal C_P^A$ in
\eqref{eq:completion:parent-marked-cycles}.
For each $u\in Y$, fix coefficients $\omega_{A,u}(C)$ on
$\mathcal C_P^A$. Also fix coefficients $w_0(W(C,u))$
for $C\in\mathcal C_P^A$ and $u\in B$.
Each coefficient lies in $[0,b_+a^{1-c}]$.

Let $\mathcal Q,\widetilde{\mathcal Q}$ be marked completion
hosts on $(P,V,U,\pi)$ with separation parameter $d$, and let $u_{\rm ch}\ge0$. Suppose
$\Delta_*(\mathcal Q\triangle\widetilde{\mathcal Q})\le u_{\rm ch}$.
All candidate families and coefficient functions are the same
at the two hosts.

Each quantity below changes by at most $C_{\rm mark}u_{\rm ch}/a$,
for every choice of its roots in the indicated range:
\[
\begin{array}{l|l}
 \text{quantity}&\text{root range}\\\hline
 \widehat Z^A_{v,u,j}
   &v\in A,\ u\in Y,\ j\in\{0,K\}\\
 a^{-c}|\mathcal C^A(u)|&u\in Y\\
 a^{1-c}|\mathcal F_j^A(v,v';u)|
   &v,v'\in A,\ v\ne v',\ u\in Y,\ j\in\{0,K\}\\
 \widehat L_e&\text{every potential typed rim occurrence or spoke }e\\
 a^{-c}|\mathcal C(u,u')|&u,u'\in B,\ u\ne u'\\
 a^{1-c}|\mathcal F_j(v,v';u,u')|
   &v,v'\in A,\ v\ne v',\ u,u'\in B,\ u\ne u',\ j\in\{0,K\}
\end{array}
\]
The wheel and two-hub quantities use the parts $(A,B)$; in the
fourth row, $e$ ranges over the potential occurrences on
$(P[A],A,B,\pi|_A)$, including roots absent from either host.
The local load uses $\omega_{A,u}$ and omits $(v,u,j)$, and the
one-hub path count omits both root spokes. The wheel load uses
$w_0$ and omits precisely $e$, and the two-hub path count omits
all four root spokes. All rim labels lie in $A$, and all these
families use separation $(3d,\pi)$ and their prescribed types,
directions and physical images.
No separation between the two fixed roots of a path is imposed.
Both potential loads include roots absent from either host.

For each individual quantity, it suffices to bound the changed
nonomitted occurrences appearing in its defining products,
after restricting to its free-label domains and fixed roots.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: def:common:marked-estimates
statements.title: Common marked cycle estimates
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Common marked cycle estimates]
\label{def:common:marked-estimates}
Let $c\ge8$ and $b\ge1$ be integers, and let $q>0$, $\eta_0\ge0$ and
$\beta,b_-,b_+>0$. Let $P$ be a graph on $V$, $|V|=n$, let
$\pi$ be a permutation of $V$, and let
$\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a physically injective typed graph
on disjoint sets $V,W$, with physical rim images in $P$. Fix distinct $u,u'\in W$ and $\kappa\in\{0,1\}^V$.
Put $A_0=N_{H^{K}}(u)\cap N_{H^{K}}(u')$ and
$B_0=\{v\in N_{H^{0}}(u)\cap N_{H^{0}}(u'):\kappa_v=1\}$.
Use $\mathcal C_P$, $\mathcal C_{\mathcal Q}(u,u';A_0,B_0)$ and
$\mathcal F_j^{A_0,B_0}(v,v';u,u')$ from the preceding paragraph,
with separation $(b,\pi)$, and the load \eqref{eq:loads:common-marked}.
The class-size estimates are
\begin{equation}
 \bigl||A_0|-qn\bigr|,\ 
 \bigl||B_0|-(c-1)qn\bigr|\le\eta_0 n,
 \qquad |B_0\cap\pi(A_0)|\le\eta_0 n.
 \label{eq:common:class-size-input}
\end{equation}

For $\phi:\mathcal C_P\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$, define
$Z_{v,j}$ by \eqref{eq:loads:common-marked}. The weight and count estimates are
\begin{equation}
\begin{gathered}
b_-n^{1-c}\le\phi(C)\le b_+n^{1-c}\quad(C\in\mathcal C_P),\qquad
|Z_{v,j}-1|\le\eta_0\quad(v\in V,\ j\in\{0,K\}),\\
|\mathcal C_{\mathcal Q}(u,u';A_0,B_0)|\ge\beta n^c,\qquad
|\mathcal F_j^{A_0,B_0}(v,v';u,u')|\ge\beta n^{c-1}
\quad(v\ne v'\in V,\ j\in\{0,K\}).
\end{gathered}
\label{eq:common:weight-count-input}
\end{equation}

We say that $(\kappa,\phi)$ satisfies the common marked cycle estimates
on $\mathcal Q$ at $u,u'$ relative to $(P,\pi)$ with parameters
$(c,b,q,\eta_0,\beta,b_-,b_+)$ if these two displayed conditions hold.

For $q_*>0$, we say that $\mathcal Q$ has \emph{common marked cycle estimates for
all index pairs}, relative to $(P,\pi)$ with parameters
$(c,b,q_*,\eta_0,\beta,b_-,b_+)$, if there are
$q\ge q_*$ and $\phi:\mathcal C_P\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ such that,
for every distinct $u,u'\in W$, there is
$\kappa^{u,u'}\in\{0,1\}^V$ for which $(\kappa^{u,u'},\phi)$
satisfies the pairwise estimates with parameters
$(c,b,q,\eta_0,\beta,b_-,b_+)$. 
\end{definition}

statements.label: thm:new:marked-relative-absorber
statements.title: Bounded marked absorbers
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{theorem}[Bounded marked absorbers]
\label{thm:new:marked-relative-absorber}
Fix an even integer $c\ge8$ and constants
$\alpha,p_*,\omega,\beta,b_-,b_+>0$ with $b_-\le b_+$.
There exist $\varepsilon,\eta_0,\epsilon_*>0$ such that, for every
integer $d\ge2$ and every integer $m_0\ge0$, there is $M\in\mathbb N$
with the following property. For every integer $f\ge0$ there is
$n_0\in\mathbb N$ such that the following holds for $n\ge n_0$.

Let $\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a physically injective typed
graph on disjoint sets $V,W$, with permutation $\pi$ of $V$
and physical rim images in a graph $P$ on $V$. Assume
\[
 \operatorname{dist}_\pi(x,y)>3d
 \quad(x\to y\in E(R^0)\cup E(R^K)).
\]
Suppose
\[
 |V|=n,\quad \omega n\le|W|\le n,\quad
 \delta(P)\ge(1/2+\alpha)n,\quad L_\pi>10(c+7)(4d+1).
\]
Let $p_0,p_K\in[p_*,1]$ and $s_0,s_K:W\to[p_*,1]$.
Use these densities, $E_j=E_j(P,\pi,3d)$ and $F=F_{\pi,3d}$ in
the counts and targets of \eqref{eq:cn:marked-row-count} and
\eqref{eq:cn:marked-index-count}. Assume the following.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item\label{item:marked-relative-absorber:typicality}
For every row pattern $i$ with $S_j^\pm,T_j^\pm\subseteq V$,
$J_0,J_K\subseteq W$, and
\[
 T_j^\pm=\varnothing,\qquad
 \sum_{j\in\{0,K\}}(|S_j^+|+|S_j^-|)\le2,\qquad |J_0|+|J_K|\le2,
\]
we have $N_V^{\rm mark}(V;i)\ge\mu_V^{\rm mark}(V;i)-\varepsilon n$.
For all disjoint $S_0,S_K\subseteq V$ with $(3d,\pi)$-separated union
and $|S_0|+|S_K|\le c+6$, we have
\[
 N_U^{\rm mark}(W;S_0,S_K)
 \ge\sum_{u\in W}s_0(u)^{|S_0|}s_K(u)^{|S_K|}-\varepsilon|W|.
\]
\item\label{item:marked-relative-absorber:common}
$\mathcal Q$ has common marked cycle estimates for all index pairs,
relative to $(P,\pi)$ with parameters
$(c,3d,p_*^2,\eta_0,\beta,b_-,b_+)$.
\end{enumerate}

Let $L\subseteq\mathcal Q$ be marked $c$-wheel-divisible, on at most $m_0$ auxiliary vertices.
Let $I_V\subseteq V$ and $I_W\subseteq W$ satisfy
$|I_V|,|I_W|\le\epsilon_*n$. Let
$I_0\subseteq(V\dot\cup W)\setminus V(L)$ and let $F_0$ be a
physical edge set with $|I_0|+|F_0|\le f$.

Then $L$ has a marked $c$-wheel absorber $A_L\subseteq\mathcal Q$.
Writing $N_L=V(A_L)\setminus V(L)$, we have
\[
 |N_L|\le M,\quad N_L\cap(I_V\cup I_W\cup I_0)=\varnothing,\quad
 E_{\rm phys}(A_L)\cap F_0=\varnothing,\quad E(A_L[V(L)])=\varnothing.
\]
The set $N_L\cap V$ is $(3d,\pi)$-separated and is
$(3d,\pi)$-separated from $V(L)\cap V$.
\end{theorem}

statements.label: lem:four:common-neighbourhood-balancing
statements.title: Balancing two common typed neighbourhoods
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Balancing two common typed neighbourhoods]
\label{lem:four:common-neighbourhood-balancing}
Fix an integer $c\ge8$ and $q_*,\beta,b_-,b_+>0$ with $b_-\le b_+$.
There exist $a,a_-,a_+>0$ such that for every $\eta>0$ there are
$\epsilon_0,\eta_0>0$ for which, for every integer separation distance $b\ge1$
and integer $f\ge0$, there is $n_0\in\mathbb N$ such that the following holds for $n\ge n_0$.

Let $V,W$ be disjoint with $|V|=n$, let $\pi$ be a successor permutation of $V$,
let $P$ be a graph on $V$, and let
$\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^{0},H^{K})$ be a physically injective typed graph on $V,W$
whose physical rim images lie in $P$. Let $u,u'\in W$ be distinct and let
$\kappa\in\{0,1\}^V$. Let $\mathcal C_P$ and the common cycle/path
families be defined by \eqref{eq:loads:common-marked} and
\eqref{eq:marked:present-common-cycles}, with the displayed
$P,\mathcal Q,c,b,\pi$.

Suppose $q\ge q_*$ and $\phi:\mathcal C_P\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$,
and that $(\kappa,\phi)$ satisfies the common marked cycle estimates
on $\mathcal Q$ at $u,u'$ relative to $(P,\pi)$ with parameters
$(c,b,q,\eta_0,\beta,b_-,b_+)$.
Let $I\subseteq V$ satisfy $|I|\le\epsilon_0n$, and let
$Z\subseteq V\setminus I$ be $(b,\pi)$-separated with $|Z|\le f$.
For $j\in\{0,K\}$ put $Z_j=\{z\in Z:zu,zu'\in E(H^j)\}$, and assume
\[
 Z=Z_0\mathbin{\dot\cup}Z_K,\qquad |Z_0|=(c-1)|Z_K|.
\]

Then there exist sets $A,B_1\subseteq V$ and a function
$\psi:\mathcal C_{\mathcal Q}(u,u';A,B_1)\to\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ with the following properties:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item
\[
 Z_K\subseteq A\subseteq N_{H^K}(u)\cap N_{H^K}(u'),\qquad
 Z_0\subseteq B_1\subseteq N_{H^0}(u)\cap N_{H^0}(u'),\qquad
 A\cup B_1\subseteq V\setminus I.
\]
\begin{equation}
 |B_1|=(c-1)|A|,\quad |A|\ge an,\quad B_1\cap\pi(A)=\varnothing.
 \label{eq:common:balanced-classes}
\end{equation}
\item The weighting $\psi$ has cycle weight and absorber estimates
with paired absorbers on $(A,B_1)$ at scale $n$, with error $\eta$,
coefficient bounds $(a_-,a_+)$ and absorber coefficient $a$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: clm:marked:close-root-transformer
statements.title: clm:marked:close-root-transformer
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{localclaim}\label{clm:marked:close-root-transformer}
Let $L_1,L_2\subseteq\mathcal Q$ be vertex-disjoint typed graphs,
each on at most $r_0$ auxiliary vertices, with every auxiliary arc
having endpoints at $\pi$-distance greater than $3d$.
Suppose their row-label sets are $(3d,\pi)$-separated from one another,
and $\theta:L_1\to L_2$ is a part-, direction- and type-preserving,
edge-bijective homomorphism. If $L_1$ is marked $c$-wheel-divisible,
there is a transformer $T\subseteq\mathcal Q$ such that
$L_1\cup T$ and $L_2\cup T$ have marked $c$-wheel decompositions,
$E(T[V(L_1\cup L_2)])=\varnothing$, and
\[
\begin{gathered}
 \bigl(V(T)\setminus V(L_1\cup L_2)\bigr)
       \cap(I_V\cup I_W\cup X_{\rm ex})=\varnothing,\\
 E_{\rm phys}(T)\cap\bigl(F_{\rm ex}\cup E_{\rm phys}(L_1\cup L_2)\bigr)=\varnothing.
\end{gathered}
\]
New row labels are $(3d,\pi)$-separated from all row roots and
from one another.
\end{localclaim}

statements.label: prop:completion:ordinary-construction
statements.title: Ordinary completion after bounded changes
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{proposition}[Ordinary completion after bounded changes]
\label{prop:completion:ordinary-construction}
Fix an integer $r\ge3$, $\alpha_0,\epsilon_{\max}>0$ and
$0<\varrho_*\le1$ and $0<s_*\le1/100$. Suppose that
\begin{equation}
 0<\zeta_{\rm rem}\ll\epsilon
 \ll\epsilon_{\max},\alpha_0,\varrho_*,s_*,1/r.
 \label{eq:completion:ordinary-input-hierarchy}
\end{equation}
Assume also $\epsilon\le\epsilon_{\max}$. For every pair of integers $d\ge2$,
$L_0\ge1$ and every $\chi\in(0,1)$, there are integers
$M_{\rm abs},n_0\ge1$ for which the following holds.

Let $P$ be a simple $D$-regular graph on $V$, where $|V|=n\ge n_0$,
$D$ is even and $D\ge(\delta_{C_r}+\alpha_0)n$.
Let $U$ be disjoint from $V$, put
$\varrho=2|U|/D\in[\varrho_*,1]$, and let $s\in[s_*,1/100]$.
Fix $a_u,b_u\ge0$ such that
\[
 a_u\le1/8,\qquad
 s+b_u\le1-(1+1/d)a_u\quad(u\in U).
\]

Then there are $I\subseteq V$, $J\subseteq U$ and a permutation
$\pi$ of $V$, all fixed before sampling, such that
\[
 |I|=\lfloor\epsilon n\rfloor,\qquad
 |J|=\lfloor\epsilon|U|\rfloor,\qquad \pi(I)=I.
\]
Every cycle of $\pi$ has length greater than
$\max\{10d,L_0\}$.
Sample the ordinary completion graph $\mathcal B$ on $(P,V,U,\pi)$
with parameters $\varrho,s,d,(a_u),(b_u)$.

With probability at least $1-\chi-n^{-12}$, there is an extended
subgraph $\mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal B$ on at most $M_{\rm abs}$
auxiliary vertices, with $\mathcal A[I\cup J]=\varnothing$, such that
every ordinary $r$-wheel-divisible completion host $\mathcal R$
on $(P,V,U,\pi)$ satisfying
\begin{equation}
 \mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal R,\qquad
 \mathcal R[I\cup J]=\mathcal B[I\cup J],\qquad
 \Delta_*\bigl((\mathcal R-\mathcal A)\triangle\mathcal B\bigr)
       \le\zeta_{\rm rem}n
 \label{item:completion:perturbation:ordinary}
\end{equation}
has an $r$-wheel decomposition.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[Marked completion after bounded changes]
\label{prop:completion:marked-construction}
Fix $\alpha_0,\epsilon_{\max}>0$, $0<\varrho_*\le1$ and
$0<s_*\le1/100$.
There is an integer $c_0=c_0(\alpha_0,\varrho_*,s_*)\ge8$ such that,
for every even integer $c\ge c_0$, the following holds.
Suppose that
\begin{equation}
 0<\zeta_{\rm rem}\ll\epsilon
 \ll\epsilon_{\max},\alpha_0,\varrho_*,s_*,1/c.
 \label{eq:completion:marked-input-hierarchy}
\end{equation}
Assume also $\epsilon\le\epsilon_{\max}$. For every pair of integers $d\ge2$,
$L_0\ge1$ and every $\chi\in(0,1)$, there are integers
$M_{\rm abs},n_0\ge1$ for which the following holds.

Let $P$ be a simple $D$-regular graph on $V$, where $|V|=n\ge n_0$,
$D$ is even and $D\ge(1/2+\alpha_0)n$.
Let $U$ be disjoint from $V$, put
$\varrho=2|U|/D\in[\varrho_*,1]$, and let $s\in[s_*,1/100]$.

\[
 t+a_u\le1/8,\qquad
 s+b_u\le1-(1+1/d)(t+a_u)\quad(u\in U).
\]

$\pi$ of $V$, all fixed before sampling, such that
\[
 |I|=\lfloor\epsilon n\rfloor,\qquad
 |J|=\lfloor\epsilon|U|\rfloor,\qquad \pi(I)=I.
\]
Every cycle of $\pi$ has length greater than
$\max\{10d,L_0,10(c+7)(3d+3)\}$.
Sample the marked completion graph $\mathcal B$ on $(P,V,U,\pi)$
with parameters $c,\varrho,s,d,(a_u),(b_u)$.

With probability at least $1-\chi-n^{-12}$, there is an extended
subgraph $\mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal B$ on at most $M_{\rm abs}$
auxiliary vertices, with $\mathcal A[I\cup J]=\varnothing$, such that
every physically injective, marked $c$-wheel-divisible
completion host $\mathcal R$ on $(P,V,U,\pi)$ satisfying
\begin{equation}
 \mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal R,\qquad
 \mathcal R[I\cup J]=\mathcal B[I\cup J],\qquad
 \Delta_*\bigl((\mathcal R-\mathcal A)\triangle\mathcal B\bigr)
       \le\zeta_{\rm rem}n
 \label{item:completion:perturbation:marked}
\end{equation}
has a marked $c$-wheel decomposition.
\end{proposition}

\begin{definition}[Ordinary local cycle estimates]
\label{def:completion:ordinary-local-estimates}
Let $r\ge3$, let $V,U$ be disjoint, let $P$ be a graph on $V$,
and let $\mathcal Q=(R,H)$ be an ordinary host on $V,U$.
Fix nonempty $A\subseteq X\subseteq V$ and $B\subseteq Y\subseteq U$,
$a=|A|$, $D_A>0$, $q,s\in(0,1]$, $0<\omega_{\rm est}\le1/8$ and $\eta\ge0$.
Fix an eligible subgraph $P_{\rm el}$ with $R\subseteq P_{\rm el}\subseteq P$
and an exception graph $F$ on $V$.
Let $\lambda_A:\mathcal C_r(P[A])\to\mathbb R_{>0}$ be an exact
fractional $C_r$-decomposition with
$\omega_{\rm est}a^{2-r}\le\lambda_A(C)\le \omega_{\rm est}^{-1}a^{2-r}$.
Use these fixed coefficients in
\eqref{eq:loads:ordinary-coefficients}--\eqref{eq:loads:ordinary-neighbourhood}.
For $r=3$, let $\lambda_{A,x}:E(P[N_P(x;A)])\to\mathbb R_{>0}$
be the exact fractional matching used in \eqref{eq:loads:triangular-endpoints},
with individual bounds $\omega_{\rm est}/a,\omega_{\rm est}^{-1}/a$, for every $x\in X$.
Put $k_3=4$, $k_4=3$ and $k_r=2$ for $r\ge5$.
The host $\mathcal Q$ has \emph{ordinary local cycle estimates}
with error $\eta$ on $(A,B;X,Y)$ if
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
 \bigl||A\cap N_R(S)\cap N_H(J_0)|
       -q^{|S|}s^{|J_0|}|A\cap N_{P_{\rm el}}(S)|\bigr|&\le\eta a,\\
 \bigl||B\cap N_H(S)|-s^{|S|}|B|\bigr|&\le\eta|B|,
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:completion:ordinary-neighbourhoods}
\end{equation}
where the first bound holds for $S\subseteq X$, $|S|\le k_r$,
$J_0\subseteq Y$, $|J_0|\le2$, and the second for every
$F$-independent $S\subseteq X$ of size at most $r+6$; and
\begin{equation}
\begin{gathered}
 |Z^A_{v,J_0}(\mathcal Q)-\ell^A_v|\le\eta
 \quad(v\in A,\ J_0\subseteq Y,\ 1\le|J_0|\le2),\\
 |Z_{x,v}-m_{x,v}|\le\eta,\quad
 |Z_{x,u}-m_{x,u}|\le\eta
 \quad(r=3,\ x\in X,\ v\in E_x,\ u\in B).
\end{gathered}
\label{eq:protected:ordinary-local-loads}
\end{equation}
The neighbourhood bounds supply endpoint degrees and codegrees,
the local factor constructions and the extension sets. The load bounds
use the same fixed cycle and matching weights.
All the indicated roots are potential roots. In particular, $J_0$ is
not restricted to $B$. The targets use the degrees in $P$ and the
excluded pairs in $F$, as specified in \eqref{eq:loads:ordinary-coefficients}
and the formulas following \eqref{eq:loads:triangular-endpoints}.

\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Changes to ordinary counts and loads]
\label{lem:completion:ordinary-estimate-changes}
Fix integers $r\ge3$, $k\ge r+2$, numbers $0<\kappa,q_*\le1$ and
$c_+,b_+>0$. There is a constant $C_{\rm ch}$ depending only on
these parameters with the following property.
Let $\mathcal Q,\widetilde{\mathcal Q}$ be ordinary hosts on the same fixed domains in
\eqref{eq:completion:ordinary-neighbourhoods},
\eqref{eq:protected:ordinary-local-loads} and
\eqref{eq:protected:ordinary-full-data}.
On each domain $(A,B)$, put $a=|A|>0$ and assume
$\kappa a/2\le|B|\le2a$. Keep $P$, the eligible and exception
graphs, the orientation and the nonnegative coefficient functions fixed.
On local cycle domains assume $D_A\ge\kappa a$, $q,s\ge q_*$ and
\[
 \lambda_A(C)\le c_+a^{2-r},\qquad
 \lambda_{A,x}(e)\le c_+/a\quad(r=3).
\]
On a wheel domain assume $w_0(W)\le b_+a^{1-r}$.
Let $u_{\rm ch}\ge0$ and suppose
$\Delta_*(\mathcal Q\triangle\widetilde{\mathcal Q})\le u_{\rm ch}$.
For each permitted choice of roots, regard each expression in
\[
 \left\{\frac{N_V^{\rm ord}(A;S,T,J)}a,
 \frac{N_U^{\rm ord}(B;S)}{|B|},\ Z^A_{v,J_0},\ Z_{x,v},\ Z_{x,u},\
 \widehat L_e,\ \widehat I_e,\ \widehat T_{v,u,u'}\right\}
\]
as a function $Z$ of the host; the two expressions $Z_{x,v},Z_{x,u}$
are included only when $r=3$. Then
\[
 |Z(\widetilde{\mathcal Q})-Z(\mathcal Q)|\le C_{\rm ch}u_{\rm ch}/a.
\]
The indices range over the sets specified in the referenced formulas, including
potential roots absent from either host.
Each degree changes by at most $u_{\rm ch}$ and each restricted
balance difference by at most $3u_{\rm ch}$.
On fixed cut parts of sizes $a_1,a_2$, the coefficient in
\eqref{eq:cuts:large} decreases by at most
$u_{\rm ch}/\min\{a_1,a_2\}$, with the threshold unchanged.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Ordinary completion by iterative absorption]
\label{thm:family:completion:ordinary}

with $1/k\ll\alpha,1/r$. Fix $0<\varrho\le1$, $0<s\le1/100$ and
$0<\omega_{\rm est}\le1/8$. Let
\[
 0<\delta_{\rm bal}\ll\eta_{\rm bal}\ll\epsilon
 \ll\varepsilon_*
 \ll\alpha,\varrho,s,\omega_{\rm est},1/k,1/r,1.
\]

Let $((V_i),(U_i))_{i=0}^{\ell}$ be a
$(\beta_{\rm v},\epsilon,\varrho_*,m_*)$-vortex for $(P,U)$,
where $\beta_{\rm v},\varrho_*>0$, $\ell\ge1$,
$2|U|/D=\varrho$. Let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$ preserving every $V_i$.
Fix the cycle weightings $\lambda_A$, the endpoint matchings
$\lambda_{A,x}$ when $r=3$, and a wheel weighting $w_i$ on the
packing pair, on each of the domains at level $i$.
Fix an orientation of $P-E(F_{\pi,3d})$.

Let $\mathcal C$ be an ordinary completion host on
$(P[V_1],V_1,U_1,\pi|_{V_1})$, and put
$\mathcal C_i=\mathcal C[V_i\cup U_i]$.
Assume that, for $1\le i<\ell$, $\mathcal C_i$ has ordinary
completion estimates at level $i$ with parameters
\[
 (\varepsilon_*,\delta_{\rm bal},\delta_{\rm bal},
  \varepsilon_*/4;3/2).
\]

with $\mathcal A[V_1\cup U_1]=\varnothing$, such that
$\mathcal A\cup L$ has an $r$-wheel decomposition for every
$r$-wheel-divisible $L\subseteq\mathcal C_\ell$, including $L=\varnothing$.

on $(P,V,U,\pi)$ satisfying
\[
 \mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal R,\qquad
 \mathcal R[V_1\cup U_1]=\mathcal C.
\]
Assume that $\mathcal R-\mathcal A$ has ordinary completion estimates
at level $0$ with parameters
$(\varepsilon_*,\eta_{\rm bal},\delta_{\rm bal},\varepsilon_*;1)$.

statements.title: Marked local cycle estimates
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Marked local cycle estimates]
\label{def:completion:marked-local-estimates}
Let $V,U$ be disjoint, let $P$ be a graph on $V$, and fix a
permutation $\pi$ of $V$, an even integer $c\ge8$ and an integer $d\ge2$.
Let $\mathcal Q=(V,U,R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K)$ be a marked completion host
on $(P,V,U,\pi)$ with separation parameter $d$.
Fix
$A\subseteq X\subseteq V$, $B\subseteq Y\subseteq U$,
$a=|A|>0$, $p,k,s,t>0$, $0<\omega_{\rm est}\le1/8$, $\mu>0$ and $\eta\ge0$.
Assume $\pi(A)=A$.
Use $E_j=E_j(P,\pi,3d)$ for $j\in\{0,K\}$ in
\eqref{eq:cn:distance-eligible-arcs}, and let $F$ be the graph on $V$
joining distinct labels at $\pi$-distance at most $3d$.
Use these eligible arc sets and this exception graph in
\eqref{eq:cn:marked-V}--\eqref{eq:cn:marked-U}.
Fix a positive weighting $\omega_A$ on $\mathcal C_P^A$,
the family in \eqref{eq:completion:parent-marked-cycles}.
For every $u\in Y$, define $\widehat Z^A_{v,u,j}$ by
\eqref{eq:loads:marked-local-potential} with $\omega_{A,u}=\omega_A$.
The host $\mathcal Q$ has \emph{marked local cycle estimates}
relative to $\omega_A$,
with error $\eta$ and count multiplier $\mu$ on $(A,B;X,Y)$, if
the row bounds \eqref{eq:cn:marked-V} hold with error $\eta$,
densities $p,k,s,t$, and no fixed-neighbour conditions, for
\begin{equation}
\begin{gathered}
 T_j^\pm=\varnothing,\qquad
 h_R=\sum_{j\in\{0,K\}}(|S_j^+|+|S_j^-|),\qquad h_H=|J_0|+|J_K|,\\
 (h_R\le2\ \text{and}\ h_H\le2)
 \quad\text{or}\quad(h_R=0\ \text{and}\ h_H\le3).
\end{gathered}
\label{eq:completion:marked-row-patterns}
\end{equation}
Here $S_j^\pm\subseteq X$ and $J_0,J_K\subseteq Y$,
with $J_0\cap J_K=\varnothing$. The sampled rim neighbourhoods are
$N_{R^0}^+(x)$, $N_{R^0}^-(x)$, $N_{R^K}^+(x)$ and $N_{R^K}^-(x)$;
the spoke neighbourhoods are $N_{H^0}(u),N_{H^K}(u)$.
The sums range over $A_i^\circ$ as in \eqref{eq:cn:marked-row-count},
so the required arcs are eligible and have distinct physical images.
Require also the index bounds \eqref{eq:cn:marked-U}
for disjoint $S_0,S_K\subseteq X$ with $|S_0|+|S_K|\le c+6$,
error $\eta$ and densities $s,t$.
Finally, the potential loads \eqref{eq:loads:marked-local-potential} and the families
$\mathcal C^A(u),\mathcal F_j^A(v,v';u)$ satisfy
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
 \omega_{\rm est}a^{1-c}\le\omega_A(C)&\le\omega_{\rm est}^{-1}a^{1-c}
       &&(C\in\mathcal C_P^A),\\
 |\widehat Z^A_{v,u,j}-1|&\le\eta
       &&(v\in A,\ u\in Y,\ j\in\{0,K\}),\\
 |\mathcal C^A(u)|&\ge\mu\omega_{\rm est}a^c &&(u\in Y),\\
 |\mathcal F_j^A(v,v';u)|&\ge\mu\omega_{\rm est}a^{c-1}
       &&(v\ne v'\in A,\ u\in Y,\ j\in\{0,K\}).
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:protected:marked-local-loads}
\end{equation}
The loads include absent potential roots. The common-path counts
omit both root spokes.
The one-arc row counts supply the five endpoint graphs, the two-arc
counts supply local extensions, and the three-spoke counts supply spoke
correction. No exact class ratio is assumed in these numerical estimates.
The multiplier $\mu$ is one when omitted; it does not change the
coefficient bounds or the load targets.

\end{definition}

 \ll\epsilon\ll\delta_{\rm deg},\varepsilon_*\\
 &\ll\alpha,p_{\rm rim},\varrho,s,\omega_{\rm est},1/c,\epsilon_{\max}.

$0<s_*\le1/100$ and an even integer $c\ge8$. Put
\[

 h_D=\frac{\min\{\gamma k_*,t_*\}}{128}.
\]
Let $0<\varepsilon,\delta\le1$ and
$0<\delta_P\ll\varepsilon,\delta,\gamma,\kappa,\varrho_*,s_*,1/c$.
For every integer $d\ge2$ there are $N_0,C_d,c_d>0$ and
$K_{\rm prob}\ge0$ such that the following holds for $N\ge N_0$.
Let $|V|=N$, $\kappa N\le M:=|U|\le N$,
$\varrho\in[\varrho_*,1]$, $s\in[s_*,1/100]$ and $D_0=2M/\varrho$.
Let $P$ be a graph on $V$ with
\[
 \delta(P)\ge(1/2+\gamma)N,\qquad
 |d_P(v)-D_0|\le\delta_PN\quad(v\in V).
\]
Let $\mathcal B_{\mathcal X}$ be the raw marked completion sample
of Definition~\ref{def:completion:marked-sample}, with these parameters,
a permutation $\pi$ with $L_\pi>10d$, and any fixed marginal arrays
satisfying \eqref{eq:completion:pair-feasibility}.
Write $R^0,R^K,H^0,H^K$ for its components, put
$p=\varrho s/2$, $k=p/(c-1)$, $s_0=s$, $s_K=t=s/(c-1)$,
and write $D_{R,j}=D_{R^j}$, $D_{H,j}=H^j$.
Except with probability at most $C_dN^{K_{\rm prob}}e^{-c_dN}$,
the following hold simultaneously.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item\label{item:reference:marked:capacity}
For $v\in V$ and distinct $x,y\in V$,
\[
 |d_{R^0}^{\pm}(v)-pD_0|\le\varepsilon N,\qquad
 |d_{R^K}^{\pm}(v)-kD_0|\le\varepsilon N,\qquad
 |N_{R^0}^+(x)\cap N_{R^0}^-(y)|\ge\tfrac32\gamma p^2N.
\]
The ordinary rim satisfies the large-cut condition with parameters
$(\min\{\gamma/64,p/128\},\gamma p/4)$.
Each of $D_{R,0},D_{R,K},D_{H,0},D_{H,K}$ satisfies the
$(\delta_D,16h_D)$ large-cut condition.
\item\label{item:reference:marked:spokes}
For $j\in\{0,K\}$,
\[
 |d_{H^j}(u)-s_jN|\le\delta N\quad(u\in U),
\]
\[
 \left|\left|\bigcap_{i=1}^{q}N_{H^j}(u_i)\right|-s_j^qN\right|
 \le\delta N\quad(q\in\{2,3\},\ u_1,\ldots,u_q\in U\text{ distinct}),
\]
\[
 \left|M^{-1}\sum_{u\in U}s_j^{-2}\ind_{\{xu,yu\in E(H^j)\}}-1\right|
 \le\delta\quad(x\ne y\in V,\ xy\notin E(F_{\pi,3d})).
\]
The exceptional sets $\{x\}\cup N_{F_{\pi,3d}}(x)$ have size at most $6d+1$.
\end{enumerate}
The constants in the failure bound are uniform over the graph,
the admissible marginal arrays and the actual values of $\varrho,s$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:marked-reference-configurations
statements.title: Compatible hubs and common configurations before retention
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Compatible hubs and common configurations before retention]
\label{lem:completion:marked-reference-configurations}
\label{item:reference:marked:configurations}
Fix $0<\alpha<1/2$, $0<\kappa,\varrho_*\le1$,
$0<s_*\le1/100$ and an even integer $c\ge8$.
There is $\beta>0$ such that, for every integer $d\ge2$, there
are $N_0,C_d,c_d>0$ and $K_{\rm prob}\ge0$ with the following property.
Let $|V|=N\ge N_0$, $\kappa N\le |U|\le N$,
and let $P$ be a graph on $V$ with $\delta(P)\ge(1/2+\alpha)N$.
Let $\mathcal B_{\mathcal X}$ be the raw sample of
Definition~\ref{def:completion:marked-sample}, with
$\varrho\in[\varrho_*,1]$, $s\in[s_*,1/100]$, permutation $\pi$
with $L_\pi>10d$, and fixed feasible marginal arrays.
Put $\mathcal C_P=\mathcal C_P^V$ as in
\eqref{eq:completion:parent-marked-cycles}. Use the two-hub families
of Definition~\ref{def:marked:common-paths} with separation $(3d,\pi)$.
Except with probability at most $C_dN^{K_{\rm prob}}e^{-c_dN}$,
\[
 \widehat H_C(\mathcal B_{\mathcal X})\ge32\beta N
       \quad(C\in\mathcal C_P),\qquad
 |\mathcal C(u,u';\mathcal B_{\mathcal X})|\ge16\beta N^c
       \quad(u\ne u'\in U),
\]
\[
 |\mathcal F_j(v,v';u,u';\mathcal B_{\mathcal X})|\ge16\beta N^{c-1}
 \quad(v\ne v'\in V,\ u\ne u'\in U,\ j\in\{0,K\})
\]
hold simultaneously. The path counts omit all four root spokes;
the two row roots need not be separated. The failure constants
are uniform over the graph, feasible arrays and actual densities.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:completion:marked-reference-loads
statements.title: Raw loads for fixed successor weights
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Raw loads for fixed successor weights]
\label{lem:completion:marked-reference-loads}
\label{item:reference:marked:seed}
Fix an even integer $c\ge8$, $0<\varrho_*,\kappa\le1$,
$0<s_*\le1/100$ and $K_{\rm out},a_\lambda,C_\lambda>0$.
There are $b_-,b_+>0$ such that, for every $\tau,\eta>0$ and
integer $d\ge2$, there are $a_0,C_d,c_d>0$ and $K_{\rm prob}\ge0$
with the following property.
Consider the raw sample $\mathcal B_{\mathcal X}$ of
Definition~\ref{def:completion:marked-sample}, with
$\varrho\in[\varrho_*,1]$, $s\in[s_*,1/100]$, $L_\pi>10d$
and fixed feasible marginal arrays. Put
$p=\varrho s/2$, $k=p/(c-1)$ and $t=s/(c-1)$.
Before exposure fix $A\subseteq V$ and $B\subseteq Y\subseteq U$ with
\[
 \pi(A)=A,\quad a:=|A|\ge a_0,\quad
 \kappa a\le b:=|B|\le a,\quad |Y|\le K_{\rm out}a,\quad
 a/2\le D_A:=2b/\varrho\le2a.
\]
Identify $\mathcal C_P^A$ with its tuples starting at the marked head.
Fix a weighting $\lambda_A$ on this family satisfying all positional
arc and vertex sums in Theorem~\ref{thm:four:successor-kernel},
with $(G,n,D,b,\tau)=(P[A],a,D_A,3d,\tau)$, and
\[
 a_\lambda a^{2-c}\le\lambda_A(C)\le C_\lambda a^{2-c}
 \qquad(C\in\mathcal C_P^A).
\]
For $u\in Y$ define
\begin{equation}
 \omega_{A,u}(C)=\frac{\lambda_A(C)}{D_Ap^{c-1}ks^{c-1}},
 \qquad w_0(W(C,u))=\omega_{A,u}(C)\quad(u\in B).
 \label{eq:family:marked-seed}
\end{equation}
Both functions lie between $b_-a^{1-c}$ and $b_+a^{1-c}$ on
their respective domains. Except with probability at most
$C_da^{K_{\rm prob}}e^{-c_da}$, simultaneously
\[
 |\widehat Z^A_{v,u,j}(\mathcal B_{\mathcal X})-1|\le\tau+\eta
       \quad(v\in A,\ u\in Y,\ j\in\{0,K\}),
\]
\[
 |\widehat L_e(\mathcal B_{\mathcal X}[A\cup B];w_0)-1|\le\tau+\eta
       \quad(e\text{ a potential typed rim occurrence or spoke on }(A,B)).
\]
These loads include absent roots and omit their root indicators.
The failure constants are uniform over the local and ambient orders,
the graph, feasible arrays, actual densities and every weighting
fixed before exposure with these properties.
\end{lemma}
