statements.label: lem:reconstruction:reserved-paths
statements.title: Disjoint reserved paths in prescribed cycles
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Disjoint reserved paths in prescribed cycles]
\label{lem:reconstruction:reserved-paths}
Let $c,d\in\mathbb N$ and put $L_0=cd+5$.
Let $F$ be a $2$-factor, let $C_1,\ldots,C_k$ be distinct specified
cycles of $F$ with lengths $h_1,\ldots,h_k$, where $k\ge0$, and let
$t_1,\ldots,t_m\in[1,d]$ be integers, where $m\ge0$.
Suppose
\[
 m\le\sum_{j=1}^k\left\lfloor h_j/L_0\right\rfloor.
\]
Then there are paths
$P_i\subseteq\widehat P_i\subseteq\bigcup_{j=1}^k C_j$ for $i\in[m]$
such that $|E(P_i)|=ct_i$, $\widehat P_i$ extends $P_i$ by two
edges at each end along its cycle, and the paths
$\widehat P_1,\ldots,\widehat P_m$ are vertex-disjoint.
If the specified cycles have fixed cyclic orientations, the paths
may be taken with the induced directions.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: def:reconstruction:interval-assignment
statements.title: Interval assignments and their pair graphs
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{definition}[Interval assignments and their pair graphs]
\label{def:reconstruction:interval-assignment}
Let $c\ge3$ be an integer, let $V,W$ be disjoint finite sets,
and let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$.
For $w\in W$, let $\mathcal I_w$ be an indexed family of intervals
of $\pi$ satisfying \eqref{eq:interval:extended-disjointness}, with first vertices $a_I$, and put
\[
Y_w=\bigcup_{I\in\mathcal I_w}I,\qquad
B_w=\{b_I:I\in\mathcal I_w\},\qquad b_I=\pi^{|I|}(a_I).
\]

Let $S_w\subseteq V$ satisfy $Y_w\subseteq S_w$, $S_w\cap B_w=\varnothing$,
put $Z_w=V\setminus(S_w\cup B_w)$, and define
\[
E(H^{K})=\{vw:w\in W,\ v\in Y_w\},\qquad
E(H^{0})=\{vw:w\in W,\ v\in S_w\setminus Y_w\}.
\]

Use the ordered physical image $\operatorname{phys}^{\to}$ and
unordered physical image $\operatorname{phys}$ from
Definition~\ref{def:typed-graph}.
The graphs $H^0,H^K$ are bipartite on $V,W$.
\end{definition}

statements.label: lem:reconstruction:paths
statements.title: Paths reconstructed from marked wheels
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Paths reconstructed from marked wheels]
\label{lem:reconstruction:paths}
Let $(\mathcal I_w),(S_w)$ be an interval assignment on $(V,W,\pi)$
with parameter $c$ and associated graphs $H^0,H^K$.
Let $R^0,R^K$ be ordinary and marked auxiliary arc graphs on $V$
in the successor representation, and let
$\mathcal Q=(R^0,R^K,H^{0},H^{K})$ have a marked
$c$-wheel decomposition $\mathcal P$.

Assume that the images under $\operatorname{phys}^{\to}$ are loopless and that
$\operatorname{phys}$ is injective on $E(R^0)\dot\cup E(R^K)$.

\label{item:reconstruction:paths}
Then, for each $w$, the images of the rims in $\mathcal P$ with hub $w$
form vertex-disjoint paths $Q_{w,I}$ indexed by $I\in\mathcal I_w$,
with
\[
|E(Q_{w,I})|=c|I|,\qquad
Q_{w,I}:a_I\longrightarrow\pi^{|I|}(a_I),\qquad
\bigcup_{I\in\mathcal I_w}V(Q_{w,I})=S_w\cup B_w,
\]
where $a_I$ is the first vertex of $I$. In particular,
\[
|S_w|=c|Y_w|=|V|-|Z_w|-|B_w|.\tag{U1}\label{eq:reconstruction:vertex-count}
\]
The underlying physical edge sets satisfy
\[
 \operatorname{phys}(E(R^0)\mathbin{\dot\cup}E(R^K))
 =\mathop{\dot\bigcup}_{w\in W}\ \mathop{\dot\bigcup}_{I\in\mathcal I_w}
       E_{\rm u}(Q_{w,I}),
\]
where $E_{\rm u}(Q)=\{\{x,y\}:x\to y\in E(Q)\}$.

\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:images:residual-structure
statements.title: Residual structure after deleting selected segments
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Residual structure after deleting selected segments]
\label{lem:images:residual-structure}
Let $Q,A_0$ be given by \eqref{eq:images:residual-domains}.
Then $A_0$ is independent in $Q$, every component of $Q$ is a directed
path, an isolated vertex or a directed cycle of length at least three, and
\[
 e(Q)=|V(Q)|-|\mathcal P^{\rm del}|\ge |V(Q)|-|A_0|.
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:images:residual-prescriptions
statements.title: Compatible images of selected segments and components
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Compatible images of selected segments and components]
\label{lem:images:residual-prescriptions}
With the path and interval assignments above, let
$\mathcal P_w=\mathcal P_w^K\dot\cup\mathcal P_w^{\rm ord}$ be one
physical edge-disjoint packing of marked $c$-wheels and ordinary wheels
with directed rims at each $w$. In the successor representation,
an ordinary arc $x\to y$ has physical image $(x,y)$ and a marked arc
has physical image $(x,\pi(y))$; a spoke $xw$ has image $\{x,w\}$.
Suppose
\[
 S_w^K=\bigcup_{I\in\mathcal I_{2,w}}\{a_j(I):j\in T_{w,I}\},\qquad
 S_w^0\cap\bigcup_{I\in\mathcal I_{1,w}\cup\mathcal I_{2,w}}
                    (I\cup\{I^+\})=\varnothing.
\]
Let $\kappa_w:\mathcal P_w^{\rm ord}\to\operatorname{Comp}(F_w)$
be injective and length-preserving, with
$\operatorname{im}(\kappa_w)\subseteq\mathcal D_w$.
Define $Q_w,A_{0,w}$ by
\eqref{eq:images:residual-domains} and put
\begin{equation}
 X_w=A_{0,w}\cup\bigcup_{R\in\mathcal R_w^{\rm sel}}V(R)
                 \cup V\left(\bigcup\operatorname{im}(\kappa_w)\right).
 \label{eq:images:residual-construction}
\end{equation}
There is an injection $\Psi_w:X_w\to V$ extending $\phi_w$, mapping
each selected segment with index $j$ in $P=\theta_{2,w}^{-1}(I)$
in order onto $R_{w,a_j(I)}$, and mapping $\kappa_w(W)$ in cyclic order
onto $C_W$ for each ordinary wheel $W$. Moreover,
\begin{equation}
 X_w\cap V(Q_w)=A_{0,w},\qquad
 \bigcup_{I\in\mathcal I_{2,w}}(I\cup\{I^+\})\subseteq\Psi_w(X_w),
 \label{eq:images:occupied-intervals}
\end{equation}
and $\phi_w(A_{0,w})\subseteq E_w\cup B_w^{\rm miss}\cup\pi(B_w^{\rm miss})$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:simp:orientation-routing
statements.title: Balancing by directed paths of length two
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Balancing by directed paths of length two]
\label{lem:simp:orientation-routing}
Let $n,L$ be positive integers, and let $a,f\ge0$ and $\beta>0$.

Let $G$ be a simple graph on $V$, $|V|=n$, let $D_0$ be an
orientation of $G$, and let $E_{\rm el}\subseteq E(G)$.
Let $F$ be a graph on $V$ with $\Delta(F)\le f$, and let
$(t_v)_{v\in V}$ be integers satisfying
\[
 0\le t_v\le d_G(v),\qquad \sum_{v\in V}t_v=e(G),\qquad
 |d_{D_0}^+(v)-t_v|\le a.
\]

Suppose that, for all distinct $x,y\in V$,
\[
 |\{z:x\to z\to y\text{ in }D_0,\ xz,zy\in E_{\rm el}\}|
 \ge\beta n,
\]
and
\begin{equation}
 \beta n>na/L+2a+4L+2f.
 \label{eq:simp:orientation-routing}
\end{equation}

Then there is an orientation $D$ of $G$ with $d_D^+(v)=t_v$
for every $v\in V$. The graph $J$ of edges on which $D,D_0$
differ satisfies
\[
 E(J)\subseteq E_{\rm el}\setminus E(F),\qquad
 \Delta(J)\le a+2L.
\]
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:marked-indegree-correction
statements.title: Correcting marked indegrees by retyping arcs
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Correcting marked indegrees by retyping arcs]
\label{lem:new:marked-indegree-correction}
Let $n\ge1$ be an integer, let $\rho>0$, and let
$0<\eta\le\min\{1,\rho\}$.
Let $P$ be an oriented graph on $n$ vertices, let
$M_0\subseteq E(P)$, let $A\subseteq E(P)$, and let
$b\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$. Suppose that, for every $v\in V(P)$,
\[
 |d_{M_0}^-(v)-b|\le\eta n,\qquad
 d_{A\cap M_0}^-(v)\ge\rho n,\qquad
 d_{A\setminus M_0}^-(v)\ge\rho n.
\]
Then there is $M\subseteq E(P)$ such that
\[
 d_M^-(v)=b\quad(v\in V(P)),\qquad M\triangle M_0\subseteq A.
\]
Put $J=(V(P),\{\{u,v\}:u\to v\in M\triangle M_0\})$. Then
\begin{equation}
 \Delta(J)\le(1+2/\rho)\eta n+n^{3/5}.
 \label{eq:new:orientation-and-types:O2}
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:prescribed-embedding
statements.title: Embedding with prescribed images
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Embedding with prescribed images]
\label{lem:new:prescribed-embedding}
Let $0<\beta\le1$, $0<\delta\le(\beta/100)^2$ and
$n\ge\max\{100/\beta,2/\sqrt\delta\}$.
Let $D\subseteq D^*$ be oriented graphs on a set $V$ of size $n$,
and let $W$ be a set with $|W|\le n$.
For an arc $x\to y$ of $D^*$, put $\operatorname{phys}(x\to y)=\{x,y\}$;
for an arc set $E$, write $\operatorname{phys}(E)=\{\operatorname{phys}(e):e\in E\}$.
For each $w\in W$, let $L_w\subseteq V$ be $\beta$-extending in $D$.
For each $w\in W$, let $Q_w$ be a vertex-disjoint union of directed
paths, isolated vertices and directed cycles of length at least three,
with $|V(Q_w)|\le\delta n$. Let $A_w\subseteq V(Q_w)$ and let
$\phi_w:A_w\to V$ be an embedding of $Q_w[A_w]$ in $D^*$.
Put $E_w^0=E(\phi_w(Q_w[A_w]))$ and assume
\[
 \operatorname{phys}(E_w^0)\cap \operatorname{phys}(E_{w'}^0)=\varnothing\quad(w\ne w'\in W),
\]
\begin{equation}
 |\{w\in W:v\in\phi_w(A_w)\}|\le\delta n\quad(v\in V).
 \label{eq:new:prescribed-occurrences}
\end{equation}
Let $J$ be a graph on $V$ with $\Delta(J)\le\delta n$.
No disjointness between $E(J)$ and the sets $\operatorname{phys}(E_w^0)$ is assumed.

Then there exist embeddings $\Phi_w:Q_w\to D^*$, $w\in W$,
with the following properties. Writing
$E_w=E(\Phi_w(Q_w))$ and $F=(V,\bigcup_{w\in W}\operatorname{phys}(E_w))$, we have
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item For every $w\in W$,
\[
 \Phi_w|_{A_w}=\phi_w,\qquad
 \Phi_w(V(Q_w)\setminus A_w)\subseteq L_w,\qquad
 E_w\setminus E_w^0\subseteq E(D).
\]
\item The edge images satisfy
\[
 \operatorname{phys}(E_w)\cap \operatorname{phys}(E_{w'})=\varnothing\quad(w\ne w'\in W),\qquad
 \operatorname{phys}(E_w\setminus E_w^0)\cap E(J)=\varnothing\quad(w\in W).
\]
\item The union and the new vertex images satisfy
\begin{equation}
 \Delta(F)\le5\sqrt\delta\,n,
 \tag{P1}\label{eq:new:late:P1}
\end{equation}
\[
 |\{(w,x):w\in W,\ x\in V(Q_w)\setminus A_w,\ \Phi_w(x)=v\}|
 \le\sqrt\delta\,n+1\quad(v\in V).
\]
\end{enumerate}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:prescribed-positions
statements.title: Prescribing a matching and isolated images in a small remainder
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Prescribing a matching and isolated images in a small remainder]
\label{lem:new:prescribed-positions}
Let $Q$ be a finite directed graph whose components are directed
paths, isolated vertices, and directed cycles of length at least three.
Let $A_0\subseteq V(Q)$ be independent. Let $X$ be a finite set
and let $\psi:A_0\to X$ be injective.
Let $M$ be an oriented matching on $X$ and let $Z\subseteq X$.
Assume that $\psi(A_0)$, $\partial M$ and $Z$ are pairwise disjoint
and that $e(Q)\ge|V(Q)|-|A_0|$. If
\begin{equation}
 |V(Q)|\ge8|A_0|+8e(M)+4|Z|+10,
 \tag{S6}\label{eq:new:late:S6}
\end{equation}
then there are $A_0\subseteq A\subseteq V(Q)$ and an injection
$\psi':A\to X$ extending $\psi$ such that
\[
 \psi'(A)=\psi(A_0)\mathbin{\dot\cup}\partial M
                 \mathbin{\dot\cup}Z,\qquad
 E(\psi'(Q[A]))=E(M).
\]
Here the edge image is the oriented arc set
$\{\psi'(x)\to\psi'(y):x\to y\in E(Q[A])\}$.
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:prescribed-edge-assignment
statements.title: Assigning edges to indices
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Assigning edges to indices]
\label{lem:new:prescribed-edge-assignment}
Let $n\ge1$ be an integer, let $a>0$ and $0\le b\le a/16$.
Let $M$ be a simple graph on $V$, $|V|=n$, and let $W$ be a set
with $|W|\le n$.
For each edge \(e\in E(M)\), let \(\mathcal L(e)\subseteq W\)
have size at least \(an\).
For each vertex \(v\), let \(\mathcal B(v)\subseteq W\) be a set
of forbidden indices, of size at most \(bn\).
Assume \(\Delta(M)\le bn\).
Put
\[
 K=\left\lceil\frac{4|E(M)|}{an}\right\rceil.
\]
Then there is an assignment \(f:E(M)\to W\) such that
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item \(f(uv)\in\mathcal L(uv)\setminus
                 (\mathcal B(u)\cup\mathcal B(v))\);
\item $f^{-1}(w)$ is a matching for every $w\in W$;
\item $|f^{-1}(w)|\le K$ for every $w\in W$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:list:raw
statements.title: Raw ordinary list estimates
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Raw ordinary list estimates]
\label{lem:list:raw}
Fix $0<\alpha_{\rm list}<1/2$, $0<p_{\rm list}\le1/2$ and
$0<s_{\rm list}\le1$, and put
\[
 \beta_{\rm list}=\alpha_{\rm list}p_{\rm list}^2s_{\rm list}/16.
\]
For every integer $d\ge2$ there is $n_0\in\mathbb N$, depending only on
these parameters, such
that the following holds for $n\ge n_0$.
Let $G$ be a graph on $V$, where $|V|=n$, let $W$ be disjoint
from $V$ with $|W|\le n$, and let $X\subseteq V$ satisfy
\[
 \delta(G)\ge(1/2+\alpha_{\rm list})n,
 \qquad |X|\le\alpha_{\rm list}n/2.
\]
Let $\pi$ be a permutation of $V$ with $L_\pi>10d$.
Fix $q:W\to[0,1/8]$, $s:W\to[s_{\rm list},1]$ and
$p\in[p_{\rm list},1/2]$ with $s(w)\le1-(1+1/d)q(w)$.

In the local interval experiment above, with probability at least
$1-n^{-10}$,
\begin{equation}
 L_w^0\text{ is }12\beta_{\rm list}\text{-extending in }D_0
 \quad\text{for every }w\in W.
 \label{eq:list:raw-bounds}
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

statements.label: lem:new:ordinary-list-extensions
statements.title: Prescribed-list availability after changes
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{lemma}[Prescribed-list availability after changes]
\label{lem:new:ordinary-list-extensions}
Use the random graphs and intervals of Lemma~\ref{lem:list:raw}, with
the same parameters and $\zeta_{\rm list}=\beta_{\rm list}/10$.
For a digraph $D'$, put
$\operatorname{phys}(D')=(V,\{\{x,y\}:x\to y\in E(D')\})$.
On the event in Lemma~\ref{lem:list:raw}, the following implication
holds simultaneously for every
$\mathcal Y$, every oriented graph $D$ with
$E(D)\subseteq\{x\to y:xy\in E(G),\operatorname{dist}_\pi(x,y)>3d\}$,
every bipartite graph $H$ on $V,W$, and all $Z_w\subseteq V$.
If
\[
 \Delta(\operatorname{phys}(D\triangle D_0))\le\zeta_{\rm list}n,
 \quad\Delta(H\triangle\bar H(\mathcal Y))\le\zeta_{\rm list}n,
 \quad |Z_w|\le\zeta_{\rm list}n\quad(w\in W),
\]
then every $L_w=N_H(w)\setminus(X\cup Z_w)$ is
$\beta_{\rm list}$-extending in $D$.
\end{lemma}

 \operatorname{phys}^{\to}(E(R^0)\dot\cup E(R^K))=E(Q),\qquad
 N_{H^K}(w)=Y_w,\quad N_{H^0}(w)=S_w\setminus Y_w\quad(w\in U).

as in Definition~\ref{def:typed-graph}.

\[
 a^+=a^-=a^K=a^U=0,\qquad \mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal R.
\]

\eqref{eq:completion:marked-differences}. Its induced graph on
$(I,J)$ is $\mathcal B[I\cup J]$, and
\[
 \Delta_*\bigl((\mathcal R-\mathcal A)\triangle\mathcal B\bigr)
       \le\zeta_{\rm rem}n.
\]

statements.label: clm:partition:balanced-orientation
statements.title: clm:partition:balanced-orientation
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{localclaim}\label{clm:partition:balanced-orientation}
There is an event $\mathcal E_{\rm or}$, determined by $D_0$, with
probability at least $1-n^{-10}$, on which the following holds
for every graph $F$ on $V(P)$ with $\Delta(F)\le\alpha n/100$.
There is an orientation $D$ of $P$ such that
\[
 d_D^+(v)=d_D^-(v)=d_P(v)/2\quad(v\in V(P)).
\]
The graph $J$ of edges on which $D,D_0$ differ satisfies
\[
 \Delta(J)\le4n^{4/5},\qquad E(J)\cap E(F)=\varnothing.
\]
\end{localclaim}

statements.label: doLpart:prop:sharp
statements.title: doLpart:prop:sharp
statements.statement_tex:
\begin{proposition}\label{doLpart:prop:sharp}
Let $\ell\ge3$ and $n\ge2$ be integers with $n$ even,
and let $t$ be an integer satisfying $0\le t<n/(2(\ell-1))$.
Then there is a locally balanced $\ell$-cyclic graph $G$ with classes
$V_0,\ldots,V_{\ell-1}$ of size $n$, such that
\[
 d_G(v;V_{i-1})=d_G(v;V_{i+1})=n/2+t\quad(v\in V_i),
\]
and $G$ has no fractional part-respecting $C_\ell$-decomposition.
\end{proposition}
